darslar.nomi: Orqa anatomiyasi va vegetativ nerv tizimi

bandlar: Primary curves: thoracic + sacral (concave anteriorly)
Formed in the fetal period (fetal 'C' shape)
Secondary curves: cervical + lumbar (convex anteriorly)
Cervical: when the infant lifts the head; lumbar: when it walks
postlar.izoh:
🦴 Umurtqa pog'onasi to'g'ri ustun emas - yon tomondan qaraganda unda 4 ta egrilik bor.

🔹 Birlamchi (primar) egriliklar - ko'krak va dumg'aza egriliklari. Ular homila davrida shakllanadi: homila bachadonda bukchaygan holatda yotadi va butun umurtqa pog'onasi bitta 'C' harfiga o'xshaydi. Bu egriliklar oldinga botiq.

🔹 Ikkilamchi (sekundar) egriliklar - bo'yin va bel egriliklari. Ular tug'ilgandan keyin, bolaning harakat rivojlanishi bilan paydo bo'ladi:
• bo'yin egriligi - chaqaloq boshini ko'tara boshlaganda (taxminan 3 oylik);
• bel egriligi - bola tik turib yura boshlaganda (taxminan 1 yosh).
Bu egriliklar oldinga qavariq.

💡 Eslab qolish: homilada bor bo'lganlari - birlamchi (ko'krak, dumg'aza); 'bosh va oyoq' harakati bilan kelganlari - ikkilamchi (bo'yin, bel).

rasm.manba: Rasm: Sobotta, Atlas der deskriptiven Anatomie I (1919), public domain

bandlar: Kyphosis: exaggerated THORACIC curve ('hunchback')
Kyphosis causes: osteoporosis, disc degeneration in the elderly
Lordosis: exaggerated LUMBAR curve - pregnancy, spondylolisthesis, 'potbelly'
Scoliosis: lateral deviation + rotation (torsion)
Scoliosis causes: poliomyelitis, short leg, hip disease
postlar.izoh:
Egriliklar me'yordan kuchayib ketsa yoki yonga og'sa - patologiya.

🔸 Kifoz - ko'krak egriligining haddan tashqari kuchayishi ('bukrilik'). Ko'pincha keksalarda: osteoporoz tufayli umurtqa tanalari ponasimon ezilib qoladi yoki disklar degeneratsiyaga uchraydi.

🔸 Lordoz - bel egriligining kuchayishi. Sabablari: homiladorlik (og'irlik markazi oldinga suriladi), spondilolistez (umurtqa oldinga sirpanadi) va katta qorin ('potbelly').

🔸 Skolioz - murakkab deformatsiya: umurtqa pog'onasi yonga og'adi va bir vaqtning o'zida o'z o'qi atrofida buraladi (torsiya). Sabablari: poliomiyelit (bir tomon mushaklari falaji), oyoqlar uzunligidagi farq, son bo'g'imi kasalliklari.

💡 USMLE: kifoz - ko'krak, lordoz - bel; skolioz - yonga og'ish + rotatsiya. Rasmda pastki ko'krak va yuqori bel umurtqalari yon tomondan ko'rinadi.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie I (1921), public domain

bandlar: Occipital condyles + superior articular facets of atlas (C1)
Movements: nodding 'YES' and lateral tilting of the head
Synovial joint - NO intervertebral disc
Limited by anterior and posterior atlanto-occipital membranes
postlar.izoh:
✅ Atlanto-oksipital bo'g'im - 'HA' bo'g'imi.

Tuzilishi: ensa suyagining ikkita do'mbog'i (condyli occipitales) atlant (C1) ning yuqori bo'g'im yuzalariga tayanadi.

Harakatlar:
• boshni oldinga-orqaga irg'itish - 'ha' ishorasi;
• boshni yonga egish.

Bu bo'g'im sinovial bo'g'im bo'lib, unda umurtqalararo disk YO'Q - C1 umurtqa tanasiz, ensa suyagi bilan atlant orasida disk bo'lmaydi.

Ortiqcha harakatni oldingi va orqa atlanto-oksipital membranalar cheklaydi (rasmda membrana atlantooccipitalis posterior ko'rinib turibdi).

💡 USMLE: 'HA' - atlanto-oksipital, 'YO'Q' - atlantoaksial. Ikkalasi ham disksiz sinovial bo'g'im.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie I (1921), public domain

bandlar: Between atlas (C1) and axis (C2)
2 lateral joints: inferior facets of C1 + superior facets of C2
1 median joint: anterior arch of C1 + dens of C2
Movement: rotation of the head - 'NO'
Synovial, no disc; alar ligaments limit excess rotation
postlar.izoh:
❌ Atlantoaksial bo'g'im - 'YO'Q' bo'g'imi.

U atlant (C1) va o'q umurtqasi - aksis (C2, eski lotincha nomi epistropheus) orasida. Aslida bu 3 ta bo'g'im:
• 2 ta lateral bo'g'im - C1 ning pastki va C2 ning yuqori bo'g'im yuzalari orasida;
• 1 ta median bo'g'im - C1 ning oldingi ravog'i va C2 tishi (dens) orasida. Dens orqadan atlantning ko'ndalang boylami bilan ushlab turiladi (rasmda ligamentum transversum atlantis).

Harakat: boshni chapga-o'ngga burish - 'yo'q' ishorasi. Atlant boshni ko'tarib, dens atrofida aylanadi.

Bu bo'g'im ham sinovial, disk yo'q. Ortiqcha burilishni alar boylamlar cheklaydi: ular dens yon tomonlaridan katta ensa teshigining lateral chetlariga boradi.

💡 Bo'yin burilishining taxminan yarmi aynan shu bo'g'imda bo'ladi.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie I (1921), public domain

bandlar: Cause: rupture of the transverse ligament of the atlas
Due to trauma (Jefferson fracture) or rheumatoid arthritis
Dens becomes mobile inside the vertebral canal
Risk: cervical cord -> quadriplegia; medulla -> respiratory arrest, sudden death
postlar.izoh:
⚠️ Atlantoaksial chiqish (subluksatsiya) - atlant ko'ndalang boylamining yirtilishi.

Sabablari:
• shikast - masalan, Jefferson sinishi;
• revmatoid artrit - surunkali sinovit boylamni yemiradi va bo'shashtiradi.

Nima bo'ladi: boylam densni ushlab turmay qo'yadi va dens umurtqa kanali ichida harakatchan bo'lib qoladi. Rasmda (median kesim) dens orqasida orqa miya va uzunchoq miya qanchalik yaqin joylashgani ko'rinib turibdi.

Xavfi:
• bo'yin orqa miyasi eziladi -> tetraplegiya (to'rt a'zo falaji);
• uzunchoq miya eziladi -> nafas markazi falaji va to'satdan o'lim.

💡 USMLE: revmatoid artritli bemorga umumiy narkoz va intubatsiyadan oldin bo'yin bukilgan va yozilgan holatdagi rentgenogramma qilinadi - boshni orqaga keskin tashlash xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie I (1921), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: What holds the dens in place
bandlar: Transverse ligament of atlas + superior and inferior longitudinal bands = cruciate ligament
Alar ligaments: dens -> margins of foramen magnum
Tectorial membrane = upward continuation of posterior longitudinal ligament
Wide atlantodental interval (C1 anterior arch to dens) = transverse ligament tear
postlar.izoh:
🔒 Densni joyida ushlab turuvchi tuzilmalar:

1️⃣ Xochsimon boylam (lig. cruciforme atlantis) - u uch qismdan iborat:
• ko'ndalang boylam (lig. transversum atlantis) - eng muhimi, densni atlantning oldingi ravog'iga bosib turadi;
• yuqori bo'ylama tutam - ensa suyagiga;
• pastki bo'ylama tutam - C2 tanasiga.

2️⃣ Alar boylamlar (ligg. alaria) - dens uchining yon tomonlaridan katta ensa teshigi chetlariga boradi; burilishni cheklaydi.

3️⃣ Tektorial parda (membrana tectoria) - orqa bo'ylama boylamning yuqoriga davomi; barcha boylamlarni orqadan qoplaydi.

Shuningdek dens uchi boylami (lig. apicis dentis) ham bor (rasmda ko'rsatilgan).

📏 Rentgen belgisi: atlant-tish oralig'i (C1 oldingi ravog'i va dens orasidagi masofa) kengaygan bo'lsa - ko'ndalang boylam yirtilgan.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie I (1921), public domain

bandlar: Stress fracture of the pars interarticularis
Pars = part of the arch between pedicle and lamina
Adolescent athletes (gymnastics, football); usually L4 or L5
Oblique X-ray: radiolucent 'collar' on the neck of the 'Scottie dog'
Fracture margins sclerotic; may progress to spondylolisthesis
postlar.izoh:
🔸 Spondiloliz - umurtqa ravog'ining pars interarticularis qismida charchoq (stress) sinishi.

Pars interarticularis nima: umurtqa ravog'ining oyoqchasi (pediculus) va plastinkasi (lamina) orasidagi tor qism, yuqori va pastki bo'g'im o'simtalari orasida joylashadi. Rasmda bel umurtqalarining bo'g'im o'simtalari (processus articularis superior et inferior) ko'rinib turibdi.

Kimda: o'smir sportchilarda - gimnastika, futbol, kurash, ya'ni belni qayta-qayta orqaga egish (giperekstenziya) bor sport turlari. Ko'pincha L4 yoki L5 da.

🩻 Tashxis: qiyshiq (oblique) rentgenogrammada umurtqa 'skotch-teryer iti' shaklida ko'rinadi. Sinish joyi itning bo'ynidagi yorug' 'bo'yinbog'' kabi ko'rinadi, chetlari sklerozlangan.

💡 Belgilari: orqaga egilganda kuchayadigan bel og'rig'i. Asorati - spondilolistez.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Sobotta, Atlas der deskriptiven Anatomie I (1919), public domain

bandlar: Anterior slip of a vertebral body over the vertebra below
Greek: 'spondylo' = vertebra, 'olisthesis' = slipping down a slope
Causes: degenerated or underdeveloped pedicles, or after spondylolysis
Degenerative type: usually L4-L5; congenital type: usually L5-S1
Produces exaggerated lumbar lordosis
postlar.izoh:
🔸 Spondilolistez (yunoncha 'spondylo' - umurtqa, 'olisthesis' - qiyalikdan sirpanish) - umurtqa tanasining pastdagi umurtqaga nisbatan OLDINGA siljishi.

Sabablari:
• bel umurtqasining oyoqchalari degeneratsiyaga uchrasa yoki tug'ma kam rivojlangan bo'lsa;
• spondilolizning asorati sifatida - pars interarticularis sinsa, umurtqa tanasi orqadagi 'tayanch'ini yo'qotadi va oldinga sirpanadi.

Turlari:
• degenerativ - odatda L4-L5 sathida (keksalarda);
• tug'ma (displastik) - odatda L5-S1 sathida.

Natija: bel lordozi kuchayadi. Yon rentgenogrammada siljigan umurtqa tanasi pastdagisidan oldinga chiqib turadi (masalan, L5 ning S1 ga nisbatan siljishi).

💡 Farqi: spondiloliz - sinish (siljishsiz), spondilolistez - siljish.

bandlar: Mechanism: axial compression - force on top of the head (shallow dive)
C1 ring fractured at multiple sites
Lateral masses of C1 displaced beyond the margins of C2
Transverse ligament often torn -> spinal cord at risk
CT shows the ring broken in several places
postlar.izoh:
💥 Jefferson sinishi - atlant (C1) halqasining 'portlovchi' sinishi.

Mexanizm: bo'yin umurtqalariga o'q bo'ylab kompressiya - kuch boshning tepasiga tushadi. Klassik misol: sayoz suvga boshi bilan sho'ng'ish yoki yuqoridan og'ir narsa tushishi.

Patologiya:
• atlant halqasi bir necha joydan sinadi (odatda oldingi va orqa ravoqlar);
• atlantning yon massalari (massae laterales) C2 chegarasidan tashqariga, yonga suriladi;
• atlantning ko'ndalang boylami yirtiladi.

Rasmda atlant yuqoridan ko'rinib turibdi: halqa shaklidagi suyak, yon massalar va dens uchun chuqurcha (fovea dentis).

⚠️ Ko'ndalang boylam yirtilsa, orqa miya xavf ostida qoladi. Tashxis - KT: halqa bir necha joydan singanini ko'rsatadi.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Sobotta, Atlas der deskriptiven Anatomie I (1919), public domain

bandlar: Mechanism: hyperextension of the neck (rear-end car crash, face hits dashboard)
Usually only strain of paravertebral and neck muscles
Severe: tear of anterior longitudinal ligament + anterior disc attachment
X-ray: anterior widening of the disc space (e.g., C5-C6)
Violent (football head-on): fractures of posterior cervical elements

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie I (1921), public domain

bandlar: Mechanism: hyperflexion over a lap seat belt in sudden deceleration
Usually L2 or L3
Transverse fracture through vertebral body AND arch; disc ruptured
Torn: posterior longitudinal lig., lig. flavum, interspinous + supraspinous ligs
Spinal cord usually spared; intra-abdominal injuries common
postlar.izoh:
🔒 Chance sinishi - 'xavfsizlik kamari jarohati'.

Mexanizm: avtomobil keskin to'xtaganda yo'lovchi faqat bel kamari bilan bog'langan bo'lsa, tana kamar ustida oldinga keskin bukiladi (giperfleksiya). Kamar 'o'q' vazifasini bajaradi va umurtqa orqadan oldinga qarab cho'ziladi.

Sathi: ko'pincha L2 yoki L3.

Patologiya:
• umurtqa tanasi va ravog'i orqali ko'ndalang sinish;
• umurtqalararo disk yoriladi;
• orqa boylamlar yirtiladi: orqa bo'ylama boylam, sariq boylam (rasmda ligamentum flavum), qirralararo va qirra usti boylamlar.

Rentgen: umurtqa tanasi ezilgan, qirrali o'simtalar orasidagi masofa kattalashgan.

⚠️ Orqa miya odatda zararlanmaydi, lekin qorin ichi a'zolari (ichak, tutqich) jarohati ko'p uchraydi - shuning uchun qorin KT si shart!

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie I (1921), public domain

bandlar: Discs = about 25% of the length of the vertebral column
Cartilaginous joints (symphyses) between vertebral bodies
Each disc numbered by the vertebra ABOVE it
Anulus fibrosus: outer rings of fibrocartilage
Nucleus pulposus: inner shock absorber = postnatal remnant of the notochord
postlar.izoh:
💿 Umurtqalararo disk (eski lotincha nomi fibrocartilago intervertebralis).

• Disklar umurtqa pog'onasi umumiy uzunligining taxminan 25 foizini tashkil qiladi.
• Ular umurtqa tanalari orasidagi tog'ayli bo'g'imlar bo'lib, umurtqalar orasida cheklangan harakatni ta'minlaydi.
• Har bir disk o'zidan YUQORIDAGI umurtqa nomi bilan ataladi (L4 disk - L4 va L5 orasida).

Tuzilishi (rasmdagi median kesimda ikkalasi ham ko'rinadi):
🔹 Fibroz halqa (anulus fibrosus) - tashqi, konsentrik joylashgan tolali tog'ay va biriktiruvchi to'qima halqalari. Qo'shni umurtqa tanalarini bog'laydi.
🔹 Pulpoz yadro (nucleus pulposus) - ichki, yumshoq, elastik, siqiluvchan modda. Tashqi kuchlarga qarshi amortizator vazifasini bajaradi.

💡 USMLE sevimli savoli: pulpoz yadro - XORDANING (notochord) tug'ilgandan keyingi qoldig'i.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie I (1921), public domain

bandlar: Nucleus pulposus herniates through the anulus fibrosus
Usually POSTEROLATERAL: posterior longitudinal ligament is strong in the midline
Common levels: L4/L5, L5/S1 (lumbar); C5/C6, C6/C7 (cervical)
Compresses the root ONE number below: L4 disc -> L5 root; C7 disc -> C8 root
Pain along the nerve, e.g. sciatica
postlar.izoh:
⚡️ Disk churrasi - pulpoz yadro fibroz halqani yorib chiqadi.

Yo'nalishi: ko'pincha ORQA-YON (posterolateral) tomonga. Sababi - orqa bo'ylama boylam o'rta chiziqda mustahkam va keng, yon tomonlarda esa ingichka.

Ko'p uchraydigan sathlar:
• bel - L4/L5 va L5/S1;
• bo'yin - C5/C6 va C6/C7.

📍 Asosiy qoida: churra o'zidan BITTA PASTDAGI orqa miya nervi ildizini ezadi.
• L4 disk churrasi -> L5 ildiz;
• L5 disk churrasi -> S1 ildiz;
• C7 disk churrasi -> C8 ildiz.

Natija: shu nerv bo'ylab tarqaluvchi og'riq (masalan, oyoqqa tushadigan ishias), sezgi buzilishi, mushak kuchsizligi va reflekslar pasayishi.

💡 Klinikada: L5 - bosh barmoqni ko'tara olmaslik, oyoq orqasida uvishish; S1 - Axill refleksi pasayishi, tovonda yurish emas, oyoq uchida yurish qiyin.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Adult spinal cord ends at lower border of L1-L2 (conus medullaris)
Subarachnoid space (CSF) continues to lower border of S2
Below the cord: cauda equina (nerve roots) floating in CSF
Lumbar puncture at L3-L4 or L4-L5 avoids the cord
postlar.izoh:
🧠 Orqa miya qayerda tugaydi?

• Kattalarda orqa miya L1-L2 umurtqalarining pastki chegarasida tugaydi. Uning konussimon uchi - conus medullaris (rasmda 'Ende des conus medullaris').
• Subaraxnoidal bo'shliq (likvor bilan to'la) esa ancha pastgacha - S2 umurtqasining pastki chegarasigacha davom etadi (dura mater qopi).
• Konusdan pastda umurtqa kanalida faqat nerv ildizlari - ot dumi (cauda equina) bor. Ular likvorda erkin suzib yuradi.

💉 Shuning uchun lyumbal punksiya L3-L4 yoki L4-L5 oralig'ida qilinadi:
• bu sathda orqa miya yo'q - uni shikastlash xavfi yo'q;
• igna ildizlarga tegsa, ular siljib ketadi.

💡 Eslab qolish: 'orqa miyani tirik saqlash uchun ignani L3 va L5 orasida tuting'. Chaqaloqlarda orqa miya pastroq (L3 gacha) tugaydi.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Skin -> fascia and fat -> supraspinous ligament
Interspinous ligament -> ligamentum flavum
Epidural space: epidural anesthesia needle stops here
Dura mater + arachnoid mater
Subarachnoid space: CSF is collected here
postlar.izoh:
💉 Lyumbal punksiyada igna o'tadigan qavatlar - ketma-ket:

1. Teri
2. Fassiya va yog' to'qimasi
3. Qirra usti boylami (lig. supraspinale)
4. Qirralararo boylam (lig. interspinale)
5. Sariq boylam (lig. flavum) - eng zich, oxirgi 'qarshilik'
6. Epidural bo'shliq - EPIDURAL ANESTEZIYADA IGNA SHU YERDA TO'XTAYDI (sariq boylamdan keyin 'qarshilik yo'qolishi' seziladi)
7. Qattiq parda (dura mater) va o'rgimchaksimon parda (arachnoidea)
8. Subaraxnoidal bo'shliq - LIKVOR SHU YERDAN OLINADI

💡 USMLE savollari ko'pincha: 'epidural bo'shliqqa kirishdan oldingi oxirgi boylam qaysi?' -> sariq boylam. 'Likvor qaysi bo'shliqdan olinadi?' -> subaraxnoidal.

12-postdagi (disk) atlas rasmida bu boylamlarning haqiqiy ko'rinishi bor.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Dorsal root: sensory; dorsal root ganglion = pseudounipolar cell bodies
Ventral root: motor axons; cell bodies in ventral (and lateral) horn
Spinal nerve = dorsal + ventral roots; exits via intervertebral foramen
Dorsal rami: skin of back, neck, facet joints, deep (intrinsic) back muscles
Ventral rami: anterolateral trunk + limbs; form brachial and lumbosacral plexuses
postlar.izoh:
🌿 Orqa miya nervi qanday hosil bo'ladi?

🔹 Orqa ildiz (radix posterior) - SEZUVCHI tolalar. Periferiyadan orqa miyaning orqa tomoniga kiradi. Unda spinal ganglion (ganglion spinale) bor - u yerda psevdounipolyar neyronlar tanasi joylashgan.

🔹 Old ildiz (radix anterior) - HARAKATLANTIRUVCHI tolalar. Neyronlar tanasi orqa miya kulrang moddasining old (va yon) shoxlarida.

🔹 Ikkala ildiz qo'shilib orqa miya nervini hosil qiladi; u umurtqalararo teshik orqali chiqadi va ikki shoxga bo'linadi:
• Orqa shox (ramus posterior) - orqa va bo'yin terisi, bo'g'im o'simtalari bo'g'imlari va orqaning chuqur (xususiy) mushaklari;
• Old shox (ramus anterior) - tananing old-yon devori terisi va mushaklari, qo'l-oyoqlar. Old shoxlar yelka va bel-dumg'aza chigallarini hosil qiladi.

💡 Ildizlar - faqat sezuvchi yoki faqat harakat; nerv va shoxlar - aralash.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: 31 pairs of spinal nerves and their exit
bandlar: 31 pairs: 8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral, 1 coccygeal
C1-C7 exit ABOVE their vertebra (C3 above C3)
C8 exits between C7 and T1 (there is no C8 vertebra)
All others exit BELOW their vertebra (L2 below L2)
postlar.izoh:
🔢 Orqa miya nervlari - 31 juft:
• 8 bo'yin (C1-C8)
• 12 ko'krak (T1-T12)
• 5 bel (L1-L5)
• 5 dumg'aza (S1-S5)
• 1 dum (Co1)

E'tibor bering: bo'yin umurtqasi 7 ta, lekin bo'yin nervi 8 ta!

📍 Chiqish qoidasi:
• C1-C7 nervlari o'z umurtqasidan YUQORIDA chiqadi (masalan, C3 nervi C3 umurtqasining ustidan).
• C8 nervi C7 va T1 umurtqalari orasidan chiqadi.
• Qolgan barcha nervlar o'z umurtqasidan PASTDA chiqadi (masalan, L2 nervi L2 umurtqasi ostidan).

Rasmda orqa miya va undan chiqayotgan nervlar raqamlari bilan ko'rsatilgan (N. cervicalis I, N. thoracalis I, N. lumbalis I, N. sacralis I).

💡 Bu qoida disk churrasi va radikulopatiya savollarini yechishda kerak bo'ladi.

bandlar: Motor to smooth muscle, cardiac muscle and glands
Sympathetic + parasympathetic; always 2 neurons
Preganglionic: cell body in CNS; postganglionic: cell body in a ganglion (PNS)
Adrenal medulla: innervated directly by PREganglionic sympathetic fibers
Sweat glands: sympathetic but CHOLINERGIC (muscarinic)
postlar.izoh:
⚙️ Vegetativ (avtonom) nerv tizimi silliq mushaklar, yurak mushagi va bezlarni harakatlantiruvchi innervatsiya bilan ta'minlaydi. U ikki qismga bo'linadi: simpatik va parasimpatik.

🔹 Ikkala tizimda ham periferiyada 2 ta neyron bor:
• preganglionar neyron - tanasi markaziy nerv tizimida (orqa miya yoki miya ustuni);
• postganglionar neyron - tanasi periferik gangliyda.
Rasmdagi ko'krak kesimida orqa miya nervi, unga simpatik stvol gangliyidan keluvchi ramus communicans va simpatik stvol gangliyi ko'rinadi.

💡 USMLE istisnolari:
• Buyrak usti bezi mag'iz qismi - simpatik PREganglionar tolalar bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri innervatsiya qilinadi (uning hujayralari o'zgargan postganglionar neyronlar).
• Ter bezlari - simpatik tizimga tegishli, lekin postganglionar tolalari atsetilxolin ajratadi (xolinergik, muskarin retseptorlari).
• Tos splanxnik nervlari va III, VII, IX, X bosh miya nervlari - parasimpatik.

bandlar: Preganglionic neurons: lateral horn of T1-L2 (14 segments)
Chain (paravertebral) ganglia -> body wall, limbs, head (T1-2), thoracic viscera (T1-5)
Thoracic splanchnics (T5-T12) -> celiac, aorticorenal, superior mesenteric ganglia: foregut + midgut
Lumbar splanchnics (L1-L2) -> inferior mesenteric + pelvic ganglia: hindgut + pelvic viscera
Prevertebral (collateral) ganglia exist only in abdomen and pelvis
postlar.izoh:
🔴 Simpatik tizim = TORAKOLUMBAL.

Preganglionar neyronlar tanasi orqa miyaning T1-L2 segmentlari (14 segment) kulrang moddasining YON shoxida.

Postganglionar neyronlar 2 xil gangliyda:
1️⃣ Simpatik zanjir (paravertebral) gangliylari - umurtqa pog'onasi yonida. Ular orqali:
• tana devori va qo'l-oyoqlarning silliq mushaklari, bezlari (T1-L2);
• bosh (T1-2);
• ko'krak a'zolari (T1-5).

2️⃣ Prevertebral (kollateral) gangliylar - faqat qorin va tosda:
• Ko'krak splanxnik nervlari (T5-T12) -> seliak, aortorenal, yuqori tutqich gangliylari -> oldingi va o'rta ichak silliq mushaklari va bezlari;
• Bel splanxnik nervlari (L1-L2) -> pastki tutqich va tos gangliylari -> orqa ichak va tos a'zolari.

Rasmda o'ng simpatik stvol, ko'krak gangliylari va katta-kichik splanxnik nervlar (N. splanchnicus major et minor) ko'rinadi.

💡 Splanxnik nervlar - PREganglionar tolalar, ular zanjirda sinaps qilmasdan o'tib ketadi.

bandlar: Loss of sympathetic supply to one side of the face
Ptosis (superior tarsal muscle), Miosis, Anhidrosis + no facial flushing
1st neuron: lateral medullary syndrome, pontine hemorrhage, cord lesion above T1
2nd neuron: stellate ganglion compressed by Pancoast tumor
3rd neuron: carotid dissection (painful); anhidrosis usually absent
postlar.izoh:
👁 Horner sindromi - yuzning bir tomonida simpatik innervatsiyaning yo'qolishi.

Uchlik belgilar:
• Ptoz - yuqori qovoq biroz tushadi (yuqori tarsal mushak - Myuller mushagi falaji);
• Mioz - qorachiq torayadi;
• Angidroz - shu tomonda terlash va yuzning qizarishi bo'lmaydi.
🧠 Eslab qolish: 'PAM is Horny' - Ptosis, Anhidrosis, Miosis.

Simpatik yo'l 3 neyrondan iborat. Zararlanish joyi bo'yicha:
1️⃣ 1-neyron (gipotalamusdan T1 gacha): uzunchoq miya lateral sindromi (Wallenberg), Varoliy ko'prigiga qon quyilish, T1 dan yuqori orqa miya zararlanishi (Braun-Sekar sindromi, kech siringomiyeliya).
2️⃣ 2-neyron (preganglionar, T1 dan yuqori bo'yin gangliyigacha): yulduzsimon gangliyni o'pka cho'qqisidagi Pankost o'smasi ezishi.
3️⃣ 3-neyron (postganglionar, ichki uyqu arteriyasi bo'ylab): uyqu arteriyasi disseksiyasi - og'riqli; angidroz odatda bo'lmaydi, chunki yuz ter bezlari tashqi uyqu arteriyasi bo'ylab boruvchi tolalar bilan ta'minlanadi.

Rasmda bo'yindagi simpatik stvol va uning gangliylari ko'rinadi (ganglion cervicale superius, medium).

bandlar: Preganglionic neurons: brainstem nuclei of CN III, VII, IX, X + sacral cord S2-S4
Postganglionic neurons: terminal ganglia near or in the organ wall
CN III, VII, IX -> glands and smooth muscle of the head
CN X (vagus) -> viscera of neck, thorax, foregut and midgut
Pelvic splanchnics (S2-S4) -> hindgut and pelvic viscera (bladder, rectum, erectile tissue)
postlar.izoh:
🟢 Parasimpatik tizim = KRANIOSAKRAL.

Preganglionar neyronlar tanasi 2 joyda:
• miya ustunidagi III, VII, IX va X bosh miya nervlari yadrolarida;
• orqa miyaning S2, S3, S4 sakral segmentlarida (tos splanxnik nervlari).

Postganglionar neyronlar - terminal gangliylarda, odatda innervatsiya qilinadigan a'zo yonida yoki uning devori ichida. Shuning uchun parasimpatik preganglionar tolalar uzun, postganglionarlari esa qisqa (simpatikda aksincha).

Taqsimlanishi:
• III, VII, IX nervlar -> boshning bezlari va silliq mushaklari (qorachiq, ko'z yosh, so'lak bezlari);
• X nerv (adashgan nerv) -> bo'yin, ko'krak a'zolari, oldingi va o'rta ichak;
• tos splanxnik nervlari (S2-S4) -> orqa ichak va tos a'zolari: qovuq, to'g'ri ichak, jinsiy a'zolarning g'orsimon to'qimasi (ereksiya).

Rasmda chap adashgan nervning ko'krak va qorin bo'shlig'idagi yo'li ko'rinadi.

💡 'S2, 3, 4 keeps the penis off the floor' - ereksiya parasimpatik (S2-S4).

savollar.vinyetka: A 74-year-old woman with long-standing osteoporosis is brought by her daughter, who notes that her mother has become progressively 'hunched over' during the past 5 years. Examination shows an exaggerated forward curvature of the upper back.
savollar.savol: Which spinal deformity is present?
savollar.izoh: Kifoz - ko'krak egriligining kuchayishi, keksalarda osteoporozdagi kompression sinishlar tufayli. Lordoz - bel egriligi, skolioz - yonga og'ish.

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old woman with long-standing rheumatoid arthritis is scheduled for elective surgery. Preoperative flexion radiographs of the cervical spine show a markedly widened atlantodental interval.
savollar.savol: Damage to which structure is most likely responsible?
savollar.izoh: Atlant-tish oralig'i kengaygan = atlantning ko'ndalang boylami shikastlangan. RA da atlantoaksial subluksatsiya: dens orqa miya va uzunchoq miyani ezishi mumkin.

savollar.vinyetka: A 19-year-old man dives into a shallow lake and strikes the top of his head on the bottom. CT of the cervical spine shows fractures of the atlas at several sites, with its lateral masses displaced beyond the margins of the axis.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely diagnosis?
savollar.izoh: Boshga yuqoridan kuch (o'q bo'ylab kompressiya) -> C1 bir necha joydan sinadi = Jefferson sinishi. Ko'pincha ko'ndalang boylam ham yirtiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 15-year-old female gymnast has 3 months of low back pain that worsens with back extension. An oblique lumbar radiograph shows a radiolucent defect resembling a 'collar' on the neck of the 'Scottie dog' at L5.
savollar.savol: Which part of the vertebra is affected?
savollar.izoh: Spondiloliz: pars interarticularis charchoq sinishi. O'smir sportchilar, L4-L5. Rentgenda 'skotch-teryer bo'ynidagi bo'yinbog''. Spondilolistezga o'tishi mumkin.

savollar.vinyetka: A 32-year-old restrained driver wearing only a lap belt is involved in a high-speed head-on collision. Radiographs show a horizontal fracture through the L2 vertebral body, pedicles and spinous process. Bruising is seen across the lower abdomen.
savollar.savol: Which associated injury must be actively ruled out?
savollar.izoh: Chance sinishi (kamar jarohati, giperfleksiya, L2-L3): orqa miya kam zararlanadi, lekin ichak va tutqich jarohatlari ko'p uchraydi - qorinni KT bilan tekshirish shart.

savollar.vinyetka: A 27-year-old woman's car is struck from behind while she is stopped at a traffic light. She has neck pain and stiffness. A lateral cervical radiograph shows widening of the anterior part of the C5-C6 intervertebral space without fracture.
savollar.savol: Which ligament is most likely torn?
savollar.izoh: Orqadan urilish -> giperekstenziya (whiplash). Og'ir holatda old bo'ylama boylam yirtiladi va disk oralig'i OLDINDA kengayadi. Sinish kam uchraydi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 41-year-old man has sharp low back pain radiating down the lateral leg to the dorsum of the foot after lifting heavy boxes. He has weakness of great toe extension. MRI shows a posterolateral disc herniation at the L4-L5 level.
savollar.savol: Which nerve root is most likely compressed?
savollar.izoh: Churra pastdagi ildizni ezadi: L4-L5 disk -> L5 ildiz (bosh barmoqni ko'tarish kuchsiz, oyoq orqasida uvishish). L5-S1 bo'lsa - S1 (Axill refleksi pasayadi).

savollar.vinyetka: A 30-year-old woman in labor requests epidural analgesia. The anesthesiologist inserts the needle in the midline at the L3-L4 interspace and feels a distinct 'loss of resistance' as the needle tip enters the epidural space.
savollar.savol: Which structure did the needle pierce immediately before entering the epidural space?
savollar.izoh: Qavatlar: teri, yog', qirra usti, qirralararo, SARIQ boylam -> epidural bo'shliq. Sariq boylamdan keyin 'qarshilik yo'qolishi' sezilib, igna shu yerda to'xtatiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 63-year-old man with a 50-pack-year smoking history has shoulder pain radiating down the medial arm. His right eyelid droops slightly, his right pupil is smaller than the left, and the right side of his face does not sweat. Chest X-ray shows a right apical lung mass.
savollar.savol: Where is the sympathetic pathway most likely interrupted?
javoblar: Second-order neuron at the stellate ganglion
Third-order neuron along the internal carotid artery
savollar.izoh: Pankost o'smasi (o'pka cho'qqisi) yulduzsimon gangliyni ezadi -> 2-neyron Horner sindromi: ptoz, mioz, angidroz. Yelka og'rig'i - yelka chigali ham ezilgan.

savollar.vinyetka: A 4-year-old boy ingests several of his grandmother's anticholinergic pills. He is agitated, febrile, flushed, and his skin is hot and completely dry. Pupils are dilated.
savollar.savol: Why is sweating absent in this patient?
javoblar: Sweat glands receive sympathetic cholinergic (muscarinic) innervation
Sweat glands receive parasympathetic innervation via CN X
Sweat glands are innervated by adrenergic beta-2 fibers
Sweat glands are controlled only by circulating epinephrine
Sweat glands have nicotinic receptors blocked by the drug
savollar.izoh: Ter bezlari simpatik tizimga tegishli, lekin postganglionar tolalari atsetilxolin ajratadi (muskarin retseptorlari). Shuning uchun antixolinergik dorilar terlashni to'xtatadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 6-week-old infant is brought for a routine visit. The parents ask when the curvature of their baby's neck will develop. On lateral view, the infant's entire spine forms a single C-shaped curve.
savollar.savol: Which spinal curvatures are present at birth?
savollar.izoh: Birlamchi egriliklar (ko'krak, dumg'aza) homila davrida bor. Ikkilamchi: bo'yin - bosh ko'tarilganda, bel - yura boshlaganda paydo bo'ladi.

savollar.vinyetka: During a neurological examination, a patient is asked to nod his head 'yes' repeatedly. The movement occurs without any rotation of the head.
savollar.savol: At which joint does this movement mainly occur?
savollar.izoh: 'Ha' (bosh irg'ash va yonga egish) - atlanto-oksipital bo'g'imda. 'Yo'q' (burilish) - atlantoaksial bo'g'imlarda. Ikkalasida ham disk yo'q.

savollar.vinyetka: A 55-year-old woman has chronic low back pain. A lateral lumbar radiograph shows the body of L4 displaced anteriorly relative to L5 without a pars defect. She has marked degenerative changes of the facet joints.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely diagnosis?
savollar.izoh: Umurtqa tanasining oldinga siljishi - spondilolistez. Degenerativ turi odatda L4-L5 da (keksalarda), tug'ma turi L5-S1 da.

savollar.vinyetka: A 3-month-old infant needs a lumbar puncture for suspected meningitis. A medical student asks why the needle is never inserted at the L1-L2 interspace in adults.
savollar.savol: At what vertebral level does the spinal cord end in adults?
savollar.izoh: Kattalarda orqa miya L1-L2 da (conus medullaris) tugaydi, dura qopi S2 gacha. Shuning uchun punksiya L3-L4 yoki L4-L5 da - u yerda faqat cauda equina.

savollar.vinyetka: A 45-year-old man has neck pain radiating to the middle finger and a diminished triceps reflex. MRI shows a posterolateral disc herniation between the C6 and C7 vertebrae.
savollar.savol: Which spinal nerve is most likely compressed?
savollar.izoh: C1-C7 nervlari o'z umurtqasidan yuqorida chiqadi: C6-C7 orasidan C7 chiqadi. C7 - triceps refleksi va o'rta barmoq. C8 C7 bilan T1 orasidan chiqadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 40-year-old man with a T12 complete spinal cord transection has urinary retention and erectile dysfunction months later, despite intact sacral reflex arcs at first. A urologist discusses the nerves that normally contract the detrusor and produce erection.
savollar.savol: Which nerves carry this parasympathetic outflow?
savollar.izoh: Tos splanxnik nervlari (S2-S4) - parasimpatik: qovuq detruzori, to'g'ri ichak va ereksiya. Vagus faqat o'rta ichakkacha boradi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 35-year-old woman has episodic headaches, palpitations and sweating. Imaging reveals an adrenal medullary tumor. A student asks how the normal adrenal medulla is innervated.
savollar.savol: Which fibers directly innervate chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla?
savollar.izoh: Buyrak usti mag'iz qismiga simpatik PREganglionar tolalar bevosita keladi (atsetilxolin, N-retseptor). Xromaffin hujayralar - o'zgargan postganglionar neyronlar.

bandlar: Subcutaneous glandular organ of the superficial pectoral region
A modified sweat gland; in women produces and secretes milk
Fat around glands and ducts determines size and shape
Cooper (suspensory) ligaments: skin -> deep fascia
postlar.izoh:
🌸 Sut bezi (mamma) - ko'krakning yuza sohasidagi teri osti bez a'zosi.

• Kelib chiqishi bo'yicha u o'zgargan TER BEZI hisoblanadi; ayollarda sut ishlab chiqarish va ajratishga moslashgan.
• Bez to'qimasi va sut yo'llari atrofida turli miqdorda YOG' to'qimasi bor - aynan yog' ayol ko'krak bezining shakli va hajmini belgilaydi.
• Kuper boylamlari (osuvchi boylamlar) bezni teriga 'osib' turadi: ular teridan chuqur (ko'krak) fassiyagacha boradi va bez bo'laklarini ajratib turadi.

Rasmda sut bezining tuzilishi: bo'laklar (lobi), sut yo'llari, so'rg'ich (papilla mammae) va bez ostidagi katta ko'krak mushagi fassiyasi.

💡 Kuper boylamlarining klinik ahamiyati - keyingi postlarda (o'sma va 'apelsin po'sti').

bandlar: Internal thoracic (internal mammary) artery - branch of subclavian
Supplies the MEDIAL part of the gland
Lateral thoracic artery - branch of axillary artery
Supplies the LATERAL part of the gland and lateral chest wall
Lateral thoracic a. runs with the long thoracic nerve on serratus anterior
postlar.izoh:
🩸 Sut bezi juda boy qon bilan ta'minlanadi. Ikki asosiy manba:

1️⃣ Ichki ko'krak arteriyasi (a. thoracica interna, eski nomi - ichki sut bezi arteriyasi) - o'mrov osti arteriyasining tarmog'i. To'sh suyagi yonidan pastga tushadi va bezning MEDIAL qismini qon bilan ta'minlaydi (qovurg'alararo oraliqlar orqali teshib chiquvchi tarmoqlar bilan). Rasmda u to'sh yonida aniq ko'rinadi.

2️⃣ Lateral ko'krak arteriyasi (a. thoracica lateralis) - qo'ltiq arteriyasining tarmog'i. Bezning LATERAL qismini va ko'krak qafasining yon devorini ta'minlaydi.

⚠️ Muhim anatomik yondoshlik: lateral ko'krak arteriyasi oldingi tishli mushak ustida UZUN KO'KRAK NERVI bilan yonma-yon yuradi. Shuning uchun mastektomiyada bu arteriyani bog'lashda nerv shikastlanishi mumkin (keyingi postlar).

bandlar: Tumor infiltrates and shortens Cooper ligaments
Result: retraction (dimpling) of the overlying skin
Lymphatic obstruction -> edema with 'orange peel' (peau d'orange) look
Nipple retraction may occur when ducts are pulled
postlar.izoh:
⚠️ Sut bezi saratonining teri belgilari.

🔸 Teri botishi (dimpling): o'sma Kuper boylamlariga o'sib kiradi va ularni qisqartiradi/tortadi. Boylamlar teriga birikkani uchun, o'sma ustidagi teri ichkariga tortilib botadi.

🔸 'Apelsin po'sti' (peau d'orange): o'sma teri limfa tomirlarini to'sadi -> teri shishadi, soch follikulalari va ter bezlari teshiklari esa boylamlar bilan joyida qolgani uchun botiq nuqtalar paydo bo'ladi - teri apelsin po'stiga o'xshaydi.

🔸 So'rg'ichning ichkariga tortilishi - o'sma sut yo'llarini tortganda.

Rasmda sut bezining gorizontal kesimi: bo'laklar, yog' to'qimasi, teri bilan bog'lovchi tolalar (retinacula cutis) va pastda katta ko'krak mushagi.

💡 USMLE vinyetkalarida 'teri botishi' yoki 'apelsin po'sti' = Kuper boylamlari / limfa tomirlari zararlangan saraton.

bandlar: Lymph drainage = main route of breast cancer metastasis
~75% LATERAL: nipple + superior, lateral, inferior quadrants -> axillary nodes
Axillary drainage reaches the PECTORAL group first
MEDIAL quadrant -> parasternal nodes along internal thoracic vessels
Medial route allows spread to the opposite breast
postlar.izoh:
🧭 Sut bezining limfa oqimi - saraton metastazining asosiy yo'li, shuning uchun juda muhim.

Ikki asosiy yo'nalish:

➡️ LATERAL yo'l - limfaning taxminan 75 foizi. So'rg'ich hamda bezning yuqori, lateral va pastki kvadrantlaridan limfa QO'LTIQ limfa tugunlariga boradi, eng avval PEKTORAL (oldingi) guruhga. Shuning uchun saratonda birinchi bo'lib qo'ltiq tugunlari tekshiriladi va 'qo'riqchi tugun' biopsiyasi olinadi.

⬅️ MEDIAL yo'l - medial kvadrantdan limfa asosan TO'SH YONI (parasternal) tugunlariga boradi; bu tugunlar ichki ko'krak tomirlari bo'ylab joylashgan.

⚠️ Saraton aynan medial yo'l orqali qarama-qarshi sut beziga ham tarqalishi mumkin.

Sxemada kvadrantlar, ikki limfa yo'li va tugunlar guruhlari lotincha nomlari bilan ko'rsatilgan.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

Supplies serratus anterior
Injured while ligating the lateral thoracic artery / axillary dissection
Also by stab wounds of the lateral chest wall
Winged scapula; cannot abduct the arm above 90 degrees

May also be damaged during mastectomy / axillary dissection
Weak EXTENSION of the arm
Weak MEDIAL (internal) ROTATION of the arm
Weak adduction (e.g., climbing, swimming)

bandlar: The most important muscle of inspiration
Increases vertical, transverse ('bucket handle') and AP ('pump handle') diameters
Phrenic nerves (ventral rami C3-C5): motor + sensory
Periphery of the diaphragm: sensory via intercostal nerves
'C3, 4, 5 keeps the diaphragm alive'
postlar.izoh:
🫁 Diafragma - nafas olishning ENG MUHIM mushagi.

U qisqarganda gumbazi pastga tushadi va qovurg'alarni ko'taradi, natijada ko'krak qafasining uchala o'lchami ham kattalashadi:
• vertikal o'lcham;
• ko'ndalang o'lcham - 'chelak dastasi' harakati;
• old-orqa o'lcham - 'nasos dastasi' harakati.

⚡️ Innervatsiya:
• Diafragma nervlari (nn. phrenici) - C3, C4, C5 old shoxlaridan. Ular diafragmaga ham HARAKAT, ham SEZGI tolalarini beradi (markaziy qism sezgisi).
• Diafragma chekka qismining sezgisi - pastki qovurg'alararo nervlar orqali.

🧠 Eslab qolish: 'C3, 4, 5 keeps the diaphragm alive' - bo'yinning yuqori qismi shikastlanib, C3-C5 zararlansa, bemor mustaqil nafas ololmaydi.

Rasmda diafragma pastdan: markaziy pay (centrum tendineum), qovurg'a va bel qismlari, oyoqchalari (crura) va teshiklari.

postlar.sarlavha: Phrenic nerve lesion and referred pain
bandlar: Phrenic lesion -> paralysis of that hemidiaphragm
Paralyzed dome does NOT descend on inspiration
It is pushed UP by abdominal pressure: paradoxical movement
X-ray: elevated ipsilateral hemidiaphragm
Diaphragm irritation -> referred pain to shoulder (C5) and trapezius ridge (C3-4)
postlar.izoh:
⚠️ Diafragma nervi shikastlanganda:

• Shu tomondagi diafragma gumbazi falajlanadi.
• Nafas olganda falaj gumbaz pastga tushmaydi; aksincha, qorin ichidagi bosim oshgani uchun YUQORIGA ko'tariladi - bu PARADOKSAL harakat (sog' tomon pastga, falaj tomon yuqoriga).
• Rentgenogrammada shu tomondagi diafragma gumbazi baland turadi.

Sabablari: ko'ks oralig'i o'smalari, yurak operatsiyalari, bo'yin jarohatlari.

📍 Uzatilgan og'riq: diafragma (yoki uni qoplovchi plevra, perikard) ta'sirlansa, og'riq C3-C5 dermatomlariga uzatiladi:
• yelka uchi - C5;
• trapetsiya mushagi qirrasi - C3, C4.
Masalan, o't pufagi yallig'lanishi yoki diafragma ostidagi abssess o'ng yelkaga og'riq beradi.

Rasmda ko'ks oralig'i va perikard yonidan pastga tushayotgan diafragma nervi (N. phrenicus) ko'rinadi.

bandlar: T8: inferior vena cava + right phrenic nerve
T10: esophagus + vagal trunks (CN X, 2 trunks)
T12: aorta (red), thoracic duct (white), azygos vein (blue)
'I ate (8) ten (10) eggs at twelve (12)'
Other levels: common carotid bifurcates C4, trachea T4, abdominal aorta L4
postlar.izoh:
🕳 Diafragma teshiklari - USMLE ning eng sevimli mavzularidan.

• T8 - pastki kovak vena teshigi (foramen venae cavae): pastki kovak vena va o'ng diafragma nervi.
• T10 - qizilo'ngach teshigi (hiatus oesophageus): qizilo'ngach va adashgan nervning 2 ta stvoli.
• T12 - aorta teshigi (hiatus aorticus): aorta (qizil), ko'krak limfa yo'li (oq), toq vena (ko'k) - 'T12 da qizil, oq va ko'k'.

🧠 Eslab qolish usullari:
• 'I ate (8) ten (10) eggs at twelve (12)'.
• Harflar soni = umurtqa sathi: vena cava (8 harf) - T8; oesophagus (10) - T10; aortic hiatus (12) - T12.

📍 Boshqa muhim sathlar (bifurkatsiyalar):
• umumiy uyqu arteriyasi - C4;
• traxeya - T4;
• qorin aortasi - L4.

Rasmda diafragmaning bel qismi va uning teshiklari ko'rinadi.

bandlar: Thin muscle layers in intercostal spaces 1-11; keep spaces rigid
External intercostals: elevate ribs - inspiration (exercise, lung disease)
Internal + innermost intercostals: forced expiration
Intercostal V-A-N: between internal and innermost layers
In the costal groove at the LOWER border of each rib
postlar.izoh:
🦴 Qovurg'alararo mushaklar - 1-11 qovurg'alararo oraliqlarni to'ldiruvchi yupqa mushak qavatlari. Ular nafas olish va chiqarishda oraliqlarni 'qattiq' saqlaydi (ichkariga tortilib yoki bo'rtib ketmasligi uchun).

• Tashqi qovurg'alararo mushaklar - qovurg'alarni KO'TARADI; jismoniy yuklama yoki o'pka kasalligida nafas olishga yordam beradi.
• Ichki qovurg'alararo mushaklar - jismoniy yuklama yoki o'pka kasalligida nafas CHIQARISHGA yordam beradi.
• Eng ichki qovurg'alararo mushaklar - ichki mushaklar bilan birga ishlaydi deb hisoblanadi.

📍 Qovurg'alararo vena, arteriya va nerv (yuqoridan pastga: V-A-N) ICHKI va ENG ICHKI mushaklar orasida yotadi. Ular qovurg'aning PASTKI qirrasidagi qovurg'a egatida (sulcus costae) yo'naladi.

💡 Shuning uchun plevra punksiyasi qovurg'aning YUQORI qirrasidan qilinadi (3-darsda batafsil).

Rasmda ko'krak va qorin devori mushaklari, jumladan qovurg'alararo mushaklar ko'rinadi.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Sobotta, Atlas der deskriptiven Anatomie I (1919), public domain

bandlar: Inspiration (exercise/lung disease): sternocleidomastoid, pectoralis major + minor, scalenes
Also: serratus posterior superior, levatores costarum
Serratus posterior inferior and transversus thoracis act on the ribs too
Forced expiration: external + internal oblique, transversus abdominis, rectus abdominis
Abdominal muscles also used in the Valsalva maneuver
postlar.izoh:
💪 Nafasning yordamchi mushaklari - tinch nafasda deyarli ishlamaydi, lekin jismoniy yuklama yoki o'pka kasalligida (masalan, KOAH, astma xuruji) faollashadi.

🔹 Nafas olishga yordam beradi (qovurg'alarga birikib, ularni ko'taradi):
• to'sh-o'mrov-so'rg'ichsimon mushak;
• katta va kichik ko'krak mushaklari;
• narvonsimon mushaklar (mm. scaleni);
• yuqori orqa tishli mushak, qovurg'alarni ko'taruvchi mushaklar.
Shuningdek pastki orqa tishli mushak va ko'krakning ko'ndalang mushagi ham qovurg'alarga ta'sir qiladi.

🔹 Kuchli nafas chiqarishga yordam beradi:
• tashqi va ichki qiyshiq mushaklar, ko'ndalang qorin mushagi, to'g'ri qorin mushagi.
Ular diafragmani yuqoriga itaradi. Shu mushaklar Valsalva manyovrida ham ishlatiladi.

💡 Klinikada: bemor bo'yin mushaklari va qorin mushaklarini nafasga jalb qilsa - og'ir nafas yetishmovchiligi belgisi.

Rasmda orqa tishli mushaklar (m. serratus posterior superior et inferior) va narvonsimon mushaklar.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie II (1921), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: Rib movements: pump handle and bucket handle
bandlar: Ribs 1-6 (sloped down) rotate at their tubercles
Sternum pushed forward and up: 'PUMP HANDLE' -> AP diameter increases
Lower ribs swing up and out: 'BUCKET HANDLE' -> lateral diameter increases
Quiet expiration is passive: elastic recoil of the lungs
Forced expiration: abdominal wall muscles push the diaphragm up
postlar.izoh:
🔄 Nafas olishda qovurg'alar qanday harakatlanadi?

🔸 'NASOS DASTASI' (pump handle) - yuqori qovurg'alar (1-6):
Ular pastga qiya joylashgan va umurtqalardagi bo'g'im chuqurchalarida o'z do'mboqchalari atrofida aylanadi. Natijada to'sh suyagi OLDINGA va YUQORIGA suriladi -> ko'krak qafasining OLD-ORQA o'lchami kattalashadi.

🔸 'CHELAK DASTASI' (bucket handle) - pastki qovurg'alar:
Shakli va do'mboqchalarining cheklangan harakati tufayli ular yuqoriga va YONGA ko'tariladi -> KO'NDALANG (lateral) o'lcham kattalashadi.

😮‍💨 Nafas chiqarish:
• tinch holatda asosan PASSIV - o'pkaning elastikligi hisobiga;
• kuchli nafas chiqarishda qorin devori mushaklari (asosan tashqi va ichki qiyshiq hamda ko'ndalang qorin mushaklari) qisqaradi va diafragmani yuqoriga itaradi.

Rasmda ko'krak qafasi oldindan: qovurg'alar, to'sh suyagi va qovurg'a tog'aylari.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie I (1921), public domain

bandlar: Serous membrane investing the lungs in the lateral thoracic compartments
Parietal: costal, diaphragmatic, mediastinal, cervical (cupula above 1st rib)
Visceral pleura: firmly attached to the lung, follows all fissures and lobes
The two layers are continuous at the root (hilum) of the lung

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

postlar.sarlavha: Pleurisy: where does the pain go?
bandlar: Pleurisy = inflammation of the parietal pleura: sharp pain on breathing
Visceral pleura is insensitive to pain
Costal pleura -> intercostal nerves -> localized chest wall pain
Mediastinal (and central diaphragmatic) pleura -> phrenic nerve
Referred pain to shoulder dermatomes C3-C5
postlar.izoh:
🔥 Plevrit - parietal plevraning yallig'lanishi. Nafas olganda kuchayadigan o'tkir, sanchuvchi og'riq beradi.

💡 Visseral plevra og'riqni sezmaydi (vegetativ innervatsiya), og'riq faqat PARIETAL plevradan keladi.

Og'riq qayerda seziladi - qaysi qismi ta'sirlanganiga bog'liq:
• Qovurg'a plevrasi -> qovurg'alararo nervlar orqali -> ko'krak devorida, aniq joyda, dermatom bo'ylab MAHALLIY og'riq (masalan, pnevmoniyada yon tomondagi og'riq).
• Mediastinal plevra (va diafragmaning markaziy qismi plevrasi) -> diafragma nervi orqali -> YELKAGA uzatilgan og'riq (C3-C5 dermatomlari).

Rasmda ko'krak qafasining ko'ndalang kesimlari: qovurg'a plevrasi, mediastinal plevra, plevra bo'shlig'i, o'pka bo'laklari va diafragma nervlari.

💡 USMLE: pnevmoniyali bemorda 'yon tomondagi mahalliy og'riq' -> qovurg'alararo nervlar; 'yelkaga beruvchi og'riq' -> diafragma nervi.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Air in the pleural space: dyspnea, uneven chest expansion, chest pain
Affected side: decreased fremitus, hyperresonance, diminished breath sounds
Primary spontaneous: apical subpleural bleb rupture; tall thin young male smokers
Secondary spontaneous: emphysema bullae, Marfan, infections, ventilator barotrauma
Traumatic: rib fracture, gunshot, central line, lung biopsy
postlar.izoh:
💨 Pnevmotoraks - plevra bo'shlig'ida havo to'planishi.

Belgilari (zararlangan tomonda): hansirash, ko'krak qafasining notekis kengayishi, ko'krak og'rig'i, ovoz titrashi susaygan, perkussiyada timpanit (giperrezonans), nafas tovushlari susaygan.

Turlari:
🔸 Birlamchi spontan - o'pka CHO'QQISIDAGI subplevral pufakcha yoki kistaning yorilishi. Ko'pincha baland bo'yli, ozg'in yosh erkaklarda; chekish bilan bog'liq.
🔸 Ikkilamchi spontan - KASAL o'pkada: emfizema bullalari, Marfan sindromi, infeksiyalar, yuqori bosimli sun'iy ventilyatsiya (barotravma).
🔸 Travmatik:
• to'mtoq - qovurg'a sinishi;
• teshib o'tuvchi - o'q, pichoq;
• yatrogen - markaziy venaga kateter qo'yish, o'pka biopsiyasi, sun'iy ventilyatsiya.

Rasmda ko'krak qafasi ochilgan: o'pkalar, plevra va ko'ks oralig'i o'z joyida.

💡 Har qanday turi taranglashgan pnevmotoraksga aylanishi mumkin (keyingi post).

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Air enters the pleural space but cannot exit (one-way valve)
Trachea deviates AWAY from the affected side
Mediastinal shift -> kinking of IVC -> decreased venous return
Decreased cardiac output: obstructive shock, hypotension, tachycardia, JVD
Immediate needle decompression, then chest tube

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Nose, pharynx, larynx, trachea, bronchi, bronchioles, terminal bronchioles
Warms, humidifies, filters air; no gas exchange = anatomic dead space
Highest resistance: large-medium bronchi; least: terminal bronchioles (in parallel)
Cartilage and goblet cells to the end of bronchi; smooth muscle to terminal bronchioles
Pseudostratified ciliated columnar -> cuboidal; mucociliary escalator
postlar.izoh:
🌬 Nafas yo'llarining O'TKAZUVCHI zonasi.

Tarkibi:
• yirik yo'llar - burun, halqum, hiqildoq, traxeya, bronxlar;
• mayda yo'llar - bronxiolalar va terminal bronxiolalar.

Vazifasi: havoni ISITADI, NAMLAYDI va TOZALAYDI, lekin gaz almashinuvida QATNASHMAYDI - shuning uchun 'anatomik o'lik bo'shliq' deyiladi.

📌 Havo yo'li qarshiligi:
• ENG YUQORI - yirik va o'rta bronxlarda;
• ENG PAST - terminal bronxiolalarda, chunki ular juda ko'p va parallel ulangan.

🔬 Devor tuzilishi:
• tog'ay va qadahsimon hujayralar - bronxlar oxirigacha;
• ko'p qatorli kiprikli silindrsimon epiteliy - bronxlarda va terminal bronxiolalar boshigacha, keyin kubsimon epiteliyga o'tadi;
• silliq mushak - terminal bronxiolalar oxirigacha (undan keyin juda kam).

Kiprikchalar shilliq va changni yuqoriga haydaydi - 'mukotsiliar eskalator'.

Rasmda traxeya, uning bifurkatsiyasi va bosh bronxlar.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Lung parenchyma: respiratory bronchioles, alveolar ducts, alveoli
Participates in gas exchange
Mostly cuboidal cells in respiratory bronchioles, then simple squamous up to alveoli
Cilia terminate in respiratory bronchioles
Alveolar macrophages clear debris and take part in immune response
postlar.izoh:
🫧 Nafas yo'llarining RESPIRATOR zonasi - o'pka parenximasi.

Tarkibi:
• respirator bronxiolalar;
• alveolyar yo'llar;
• alveolalar.

Vazifasi: GAZ ALMASHINUVI - kislorod qonga o'tadi, karbonat angidrid chiqariladi.

🔬 Epiteliy:
• respirator bronxiolalarda asosan kubsimon hujayralar;
• alveolalargacha esa bir qavatli yassi epiteliy.

💡 Kiprikchalar respirator bronxiolalarda TUGAYDI. Shuning uchun undan pastga tushgan chang va mikroblarni kiprikchalar emas, ALVEOLYAR MAKROFAGLAR tozalaydi; ular immun javobda ham qatnashadi.

📌 O'tkazuvchi va respirator zonalar chegarasi: terminal bronxiola (oxirgi o'tkazuvchi) -> respirator bronxiola (birinchi respirator).

Sxemada bronx daraxti va ikki zona chegarasi ko'rsatilgan.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Right lung: 3 lobes (superior, middle, inferior), 2 fissures
Horizontal fissure: superior vs middle; oblique fissure: middle vs inferior
Left lung: 2 lobes + lingula (homologue of the right middle lobe); space for the heart
Oblique fissure: 5th ICS at midclavicular line -> deep to 6th costal cartilage
Horizontal fissure: right 5th ICS (oblique fissure) -> right 4th costal cartilage
postlar.izoh:
🫁 O'pka bo'laklari va yoriqlari.

🔹 O'ng o'pka - 3 bo'lak (yuqori, o'rta, pastki) va 2 yoriq:
• gorizontal yoriq - yuqori bo'lakni o'rta bo'lakdan ajratadi;
• qiyshiq yoriq - o'rta bo'lakni pastki bo'lakdan ajratadi.

🔹 Chap o'pka - 2 bo'lak (yuqori va pastki), 1 ta qiyshiq yoriq. O'rta bo'lak o'rnida yurak joylashadi (yurak o'ymasi). Chap yuqori bo'lakning tilchasi (lingula) - o'ng o'rta bo'lakning gomologi.

📍 Yoriqlarning ko'krak devoridagi proyeksiyasi (auskultatsiya va punksiya uchun muhim):
• qiyshiq yoriq (ikkala o'pkada) - oldinda o'rta o'mrov chizig'ida taxminan 5-qovurg'alararo oraliqda, medialda 6-qovurg'a tog'ayi ortida tugaydi;
• gorizontal yoriq - o'ng 5-qovurg'alararo oraliqdagi qiyshiq yoriqdan gorizontal ravishda o'ng 4-qovurg'a tog'ayigacha.

Rasmda o'ng va chap o'pka yon tomondan: bo'laklar va yoriqlar (incisurae interlobares).

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Pulmonary artery vs bronchus at hilum: RALS = Right Anterior, Left Superior
Carina: posterior to ascending aorta, anteromedial to descending aorta
Right main bronchus: wider, more vertical, shorter -> foreign bodies go RIGHT
Supine: superior segment of right lower lobe; lying on right side: right upper lobe
Upright: right lower lobe
postlar.izoh:
🔍 O'pka darvozasi va aspiratsiya.

📌 O'pka darvozasida o'pka arteriyasi bronxga nisbatan qayerda? - RALS:
• Right Anterior - o'ngda arteriya bronxdan OLDINDA;
• Left Superior - chapda arteriya bronxdan YUQORIDA.

📌 Karina (traxeya bifurkatsiyasi) - ko'tariluvchi aortadan orqada, tushuvchi aortadan oldinda-medialda joylashadi.

🥜 Yot jism aspiratsiyasi:
O'ng bosh bronx chapga nisbatan KENGROQ, TIKROQ (vertikalroq) va KALTAROQ - shuning uchun yot jism ko'pincha O'NG o'pkaga tushadi. Qaysi segment - tana holatiga bog'liq:
• chalqancha yotganda - o'ng pastki bo'lakning YUQORI segmenti;
• o'ng yonboshda yotganda - o'ng YUQORI bo'lak;
• tik turganda yoki o'tirganda - o'ng PASTKI bo'lak (bazal segmentlar).

Rasmda o'ng o'pka medial tomondan: darvoza, bronx, o'pka arteriyasi va venalari, limfa tugunlari.

rasm.manba: Rasm: Spalteholz, Handatlas der Anatomie III (1921), public domain

bandlar: Type I pneumocytes: squamous, cover 97% of alveolar surface, gas exchange
Type II: cuboidal, clustered; secrete surfactant (DPPC) from lamellar bodies
Type II = stem cells for type I and II; proliferate after lung damage
Pores of Kohn: connect alveoli (air, fluid, phagocytes, bacteria in pneumonia)
Alveolar macrophages: 'dust cells'; hemosiderin-laden 'heart failure cells'
postlar.izoh:
🔬 Alveola hujayralari.

🔹 I tip pnevmotsitlar - YASSI hujayralar; alveola yuzasining 97 foizini yupqa qatlam bilan qoplaydi - optimal gaz almashinuvi uchun.

🔹 II tip pnevmotsitlar - KUBSIMON, guruh bo'lib joylashadi; 2 vazifasi bor:
1. I va II tip hujayralarning o'zak (prekursor) hujayrasi - o'pka shikastlanganda ko'payib, uni tiklaydi;
2. lamellyar tanachalardan SURFAKTANT ajratadi.

🔹 Kon teshikchalari (pori alveolares) - qo'shni alveolalarni bog'laydi; ular orqali havo, suyuqlik, fagotsitlar va pnevmoniyada BAKTERIYALAR ham o'tadi.

🔹 Alveolyar makrofaglar - yot moddalarni fagotsitoz qiladi, sitokin va proteazalar ajratadi. Boshqa nomlari:
• 'chang hujayralari' - chang va sigaret zarrachalarini yutganlar;
• 'yurak nuqsoni hujayralari' - yurak yetishmovchiligida alveolaga chiqqan eritrotsitlarni yutib, gemosideringa to'lganlar (o'pka shishi, alveolyar qon quyilish).

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Surfactant: lowers surface tension -> less collapse, less recoil, more compliance
Mainly lecithins - dipalmitoylphosphatidylcholine (DPPC)
Laplace: collapsing pressure = 2T / r -> small alveoli collapse on expiration
Synthesis from ~20 weeks, mature ~35 weeks; glucocorticoids help
NRDS: prematurity, maternal diabetes, C-section; L/S < 1.5; ground-glass X-ray
postlar.izoh:
🫧 Surfaktant va chaqaloqlarning respirator distress sindromi (RDS).

Surfaktant: alveolalardagi sirt tarangligini KAMAYTIRADI -> alveolalar yopishib qolmaydi, o'pka cho'ziluvchanligi oshadi. Asosiy komponenti - letsitinlar, ayniqsa dipalmitoilfosfatidilxolin (DPPC).

📐 Laplas qonuni: yopilish bosimi = 2 x sirt tarangligi / radius. Nafas chiqarishda radius kichrayadi -> alveola yopilishga moyil. Surfaktant aynan shuni oldini oladi.

⏳ Sintez ~20-haftada boshlanadi, ~35-haftada yetarli darajaga yetadi. Glyukokortikoidlar homila o'pkasining yetilishi uchun muhim.

👶 RDS - surfaktant yetishmasligi: sirt tarangligi oshadi, alveolalar yopiladi, rentgenda 'xira oyna'.
Xavf omillari:
• chala tug'ilish;
• onadagi diabet (homila insulini surfaktant sintezini susaytiradi);
• kesarcha kesish (stress kam -> homila glyukokortikoidlari kam).

Tashxis: amniotik suyuqlikda L/S nisbati - 2 va undan yuqori - me'yor, 1.5 dan past - RDS xavfi.
💊 Davolash: tug'ruqdan oldin onaga glyukokortikoid, chaqaloqqa surfaktant. Kislorod asoratlari - RIB: retinopatiya, qorinchaga qon quyilish, bronxopulmonal displaziya; doimiy past kislorod - ochiq arterial yo'lak xavfi.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

savollar.vinyetka: A 52-year-old woman notices a painless lump in her left breast. On examination there is a firm 3-cm mass in the upper outer quadrant, and the overlying skin is retracted and dimpled, resembling orange peel.
savollar.savol: Involvement of which structures best explains the skin dimpling?
savollar.izoh: O'sma Kuper (osuvchi) boylamlarini tortadi -> teri botadi, 'apelsin po'sti'. Kuper boylamlari bezni teriga va chuqur fassiyaga bog'laydi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 47-year-old woman has a biopsy-proven carcinoma in the upper medial quadrant of the right breast. Axillary lymph nodes are clinically negative.
savollar.savol: Which lymph nodes are most likely to receive the earliest metastases from this tumor?
savollar.izoh: Medial kvadrant limfasi asosan parasternal tugunlarga (ichki ko'krak tomirlari bo'ylab) boradi. Shu yo'l orqali saraton qarama-qarshi sut beziga ham o'tadi.

savollar.vinyetka: Three weeks after a modified radical mastectomy with axillary node dissection, a 55-year-old woman cannot raise her arm above shoulder level. When she pushes against a wall, the medial border of her scapula protrudes posteriorly.
savollar.savol: Which nerve was most likely injured during surgery?
savollar.izoh: Qanotsimon kurak = uzun ko'krak nervi (C5-C7) -> oldingi tishli mushak. Lateral ko'krak arteriyasini bog'lashda shikastlanadi; qo'l 90° dan yuqori ko'tarilmaydi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 45-year-old man develops a right subphrenic abscess after an appendectomy. In addition to fever and right upper quadrant pain, he complains of pain at the tip of his right shoulder.
savollar.savol: The shoulder pain is carried by sensory fibers of which spinal cord segments?
savollar.izoh: Diafragma markaziy qismining sezgisi diafragma nervi (C3-C5) orqali. Shuning uchun og'riq shu segmentlarning teri sohasi - yelkaga uzatiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: During an anatomy session, students trace the structures passing through the diaphragm. One opening lies at the level of the T8 vertebra within the central tendon.
savollar.savol: Which structures pass through this opening?
javoblar: Inferior vena cava and right phrenic nerve
Aorta, thoracic duct and azygos vein
savollar.izoh: 'I ate (8) ten (10) eggs at twelve (12)': T8 - pastki kovak vena (+ o'ng diafragma nervi), T10 - qizilo'ngach va vagus, T12 - aorta, ko'krak limfa yo'li, toq vena.

savollar.vinyetka: A 30-year-old man is stabbed in the right chest. The knife entered the intercostal space immediately below the inferior border of the 6th rib and passed deep to the internal intercostal muscle.
savollar.savol: Which structures are most at risk at this location?
savollar.izoh: Qovurg'alararo vena, arteriya va nerv (V-A-N) qovurg'aning PASTKI qirrasidagi egatda, ichki va eng ichki qovurg'alararo mushaklar orasida yotadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 24-year-old man with right lower lobe pneumonia has sharp, localized pain over the right lateral chest wall that worsens with each deep breath.
savollar.savol: This pain is transmitted by which nerves?
savollar.izoh: Qovurg'a (kostal) plevrasi qovurg'alararo nervlar bilan innervatsiya qilinadi -> devorda mahalliy og'riq. Mediastinal plevra og'rig'i diafragma nervi orqali yelkaga uzatiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 28-year-old man is brought in after a motorcycle crash. He is dyspneic, BP 78/40, HR 132, with distended neck veins. Breath sounds are absent on the left, and the trachea is shifted to the right.
savollar.savol: What is the most appropriate immediate step?
javoblar: Needle decompression of the left chest
savollar.izoh: Taranglashgan pnevmotoraks - klinik tashxis: traxeya sog' tomonga og'gan, gipotenziya, venalar bo'rtgan. Rentgen kutilmaydi, darhol igna dekompressiyasi, keyin drenaj.

savollar.vinyetka: A 70-year-old bedridden man with dysphagia after a stroke develops fever and cough. He has been lying supine most of the day. Chest imaging shows a new infiltrate consistent with aspiration pneumonia.
savollar.savol: Which lung segment is most likely involved?
javoblar: Superior segment of the right lower lobe
Apical segment of the left upper lobe
Basal segments of the left lower lobe
savollar.izoh: Aspiratsiya ko'pincha o'ng o'pkaga (o'ng bosh bronx kengroq, tikroq, kaltaroq). Chalqancha yotganda - o'ng pastki bo'lakning yuqori segmenti.

savollar.vinyetka: A boy born at 29 weeks of gestation to a mother with poorly controlled diabetes develops grunting, nasal flaring and retractions within hours of birth. Chest X-ray shows diffuse bilateral ground-glass opacities.
savollar.savol: Deficient function of which cell type is the primary cause?
savollar.izoh: Chaqaloqlar RDS: II tip pnevmotsitlar surfaktantni yetarli ishlab chiqarmaydi. Chala tug'ilish va onadagi diabet (homila insulini) xavfni oshiradi. L/S < 1.5.

savollar.vinyetka: Two weeks after a left mastectomy with axillary node dissection, a 50-year-old woman reports difficulty climbing a ladder and pulling herself up. Shoulder abduction is normal, and the scapula does not wing. Extension and internal rotation of the arm are weak.
savollar.savol: Which nerve was most likely injured?
savollar.izoh: Ko'krak-orqa nervi -> orqaning eng keng mushagi: qo'lni orqaga uzatish va ichkariga burish kuchsiz. Qanotsimon kurak bo'lsa - uzun ko'krak nervi.

savollar.vinyetka: After a cardiac operation, a 64-year-old man becomes short of breath. Fluoroscopy shows that during inspiration the left hemidiaphragm moves upward while the right moves downward.
savollar.savol: Injury to which nerve explains this finding?
savollar.izoh: Diafragma nervi shikastlansa, gumbaz falajlanadi va nafas olganda qorin bosimi bilan yuqoriga ko'tariladi - paradoksal harakat. Rentgenda gumbaz baland.

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old man has progressive dysphagia. Imaging shows a tumor at the gastroesophageal region where the esophagus passes through the diaphragm together with two nerve trunks.
savollar.savol: At which vertebral level does this opening lie?
savollar.izoh: Qizilo'ngach teshigi T10 da: qizilo'ngach va vagus stvollari. T8 - pastki kovak vena, T12 - aorta, ko'krak limfa yo'li, toq vena.

savollar.vinyetka: A 21-year-old tall, thin man who smokes has sudden right-sided pleuritic chest pain and dyspnea while sitting at his desk. The right side shows hyperresonance and absent breath sounds. Blood pressure is normal and the trachea is midline.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely cause?
javoblar: Rupture of an apical subpleural bleb
savollar.izoh: Birlamchi spontan pnevmotoraks: baland, ozg'in, chekuvchi yosh erkak - o'pka cho'qqisidagi subplevral pufakcha yoriladi. Ikkilamchi - kasal o'pkada (emfizema).

savollar.vinyetka: A pulmonology student is measuring airway resistance along the bronchial tree with a catheter. She expects the total resistance to be lowest at the most distal conducting airways.
savollar.savol: Why is airway resistance lowest at the terminal bronchioles?
javoblar: They are very numerous and arranged in parallel
They are lined by squamous epithelium
savollar.izoh: Terminal bronxiolalar juda ko'p va parallel ulangan - umumiy qarshilik eng kam. Eng yuqori qarshilik o'rta va yirik bronxlarda.

savollar.vinyetka: A 70-year-old man with long-standing congestive heart failure dies. Lung histology shows many alveolar macrophages containing golden-brown granules that stain positive with Prussian blue.

💉 Torakosentez (plevra punksiyasi) - plevra bo'shlig'idan suyuqlik olish (tahlil uchun) yoki qon/yiringni chiqarish.

postlar.izoh:
🧊 Qovurg'alararo nerv blokadasi - qovurg'a sinishi yoki o'rab oluvchi temiratki (herpes zoster) og'rig'ini qoldirish uchun.

📍 Igna qovurg'aning ORQA burchagida, qovurg'aning PASTKI qirrasi bo'ylab kiritiladi - nerv aynan shu yerda, qovurg'a egatida yotadi va anestetik uni 'yuvadi'. Nervning kollateral tarmoqlari ham anesteziya qilinishi kerak.

🔪 Igna o'tadigan qavatlar: teri -> yuza fassiya -> oldingi tishli mushak -> tashqi qovurg'alararo mushak -> ichki qovurg'alararo mushak.

💡 Bitta nerv yetarli emas: qo'shni dermatomlar bir-birini QOPLAYDI (nerv kollaterallari tufayli), shuning uchun og'riqni to'liq qoldirish uchun bir nechta qo'shni nervlar blokada qilinadi.

⚖️ Torakosentez bilan farq:
• torakosentez - qovurg'aning YUQORI qirrasi (tomir va nervdan qochish);
• nerv blokadasi - qovurg'aning PASTKI qirrasi (nervga yetish).

Rasmda ko'krak devorining ichki yuzasi: ichki ko'krak arteriyasi va qovurg'alararo tomirlar.

postlar.izoh:
🔻 Ko'krak qafasidan chiqish sindromi (thoracic outlet syndrome).

Nima eziladi:
• yelka chigalining PASTKI stvoli (C8-T1);
• va/yoki o'mrov osti arteriyasi va venasi.

Qayerda: ko'pincha NARVONSIMON UCHBURCHAKDA - oldingi va o'rta narvonsimon mushaklar hamda 1-qovurg'a orasida. Yelka chigali va o'mrov osti arteriyasi aynan shu tor oraliqdan o'tadi (rasmda m. scalenus anterior va medius, plexus brachialis, a. subclavia ko'rinadi).

Sabablari:
• qo'shimcha BO'YIN QOVURG'ASI (C7 dan chiquvchi) yoki anomal 1-qovurg'a;
• o'pka cho'qqisidagi PANKOST o'smasi.

💡 Nerv belgilari KLUMPKE falajiga o'xshaydi (C8-T1): qo'l panjasi mayda mushaklari zararlanadi.

Keyingi postda - klinik belgilar va tashxis.

postlar.izoh:
🤧 Rinosinusit - burun yon bo'shlig'ining yallig'lanishi.

Mexanizm: bo'shliqning burun bo'shlig'iga ochiladigan teshigi shilliq qavat shishi bilan BERKILADI -> suyuqlik to'planadi -> yallig'lanish va shu soha ustida og'riq (oldinga engashganda kuchayadi).

📍 Ko'pincha YUQORI JAG' bo'shlig'i zararlanadi - teshigi yuqori-medialda, suyuqlik og'irlik kuchiga qarshi chiqadi. Rentgen/KT da bo'shliqda suyuqlik sathi ko'rinadi.

🦠 Qo'zg'atuvchilar:
• o'tkir rinosinusit ko'pincha VIRUSLI (rinovirus);
• ustiga bakterial infeksiya qo'shilishi mumkin: tiplanmaydigan H. influenzae, S. pneumoniae, M. catarrhalis.

⚠️ Asoratlari - infeksiya qo'shni tuzilmalarga tarqaladi:
• ko'z kosasi flegmonasi (orbital cellulitis);
• kavernoz sinus sindromi;
• meningit, miya abssessi.

Rasmda boshning frontal kesimi: yuqori jag' bo'shliqlari (sinus maxillaris), burun chig'anoqlari va yo'llari, ko'z kosalari - asoratlar nega ko'zga o'tishi ko'rinib turibdi.

postlar.izoh:
🧹 Mukotsiliar eskalator - nafas yo'llarining o'z-o'zini tozalash tizimi.

🔹 Kiprikli silindrsimon hujayralar - bazal membranadan bo'shliqqacha cho'zilgan; har birining yuzasida 200-300 ta HARAKATCHAN kiprikcha bor, ular orasida mikrovorsinkalar ham joylashgan.

🔹 Qadahsimon hujayralar - bo'shliqqa polisaxaridli SHILLIQ ajratadi. Shilliq ishlab chiqarishni shilliq osti qavatdagi aralash bezlar ham to'ldiradi.

Qanday ishlaydi:
1. Shilliq qatlam havodagi chang, bakteriya va viruslarni ushlab qoladi; ozon, oltingugurt dioksidi kabi suvda eriydigan zararli gazlarni yutadi.
2. Kiprikchalar muvofiqlashgan holda tebranib, shilliq qatlamni HALQUM tomon haydaydi.
3. Halqumda shilliq yutib yuboriladi va hazm qilinadi.

💡 Kiprikchalar ishlamasa (Kartagener sindromi - dinein nuqsoni) yoki shilliq juda quyuq bo'lsa (mukovissidoz) - takroriy infeksiyalar.

bandlar: Basal cells: stem cells for ciliated and goblet cells; do not reach the lumen
Basal + neuroendocrine cells give the 'pseudostratified' appearance
Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells = APUD, DNES, Kulchitsky (K) cells
Occur in clusters, often at airway branch points (like gut endocrine cells)
Brush cells: short microvilli; may be sensory receptors (synapse with nerves)
postlar.izoh:
🔬 Traxeya epiteliysidagi boshqa hujayralar.

🔹 BAZAL hujayralar - kiprikli va qadahsimon hujayralarning O'ZAK hujayralari. Bazal membranada yotadi, lekin bo'shliqqa yetib bormaydi. Aynan bazal va neyroendokrin hujayralar tufayli epiteliy 'ko'p qatorli' ko'rinadi: barcha hujayralar membranada turadi, lekin yadrolari turli balandlikda.

🔹 O'pka NEYROENDOKRIN hujayralari - ichakdagi endokrin hujayralarga o'xshaydi. Boshqa nomlari: APUD hujayralar (Amine Precursor Uptake Decarboxylase), DNES (diffuz neyroendokrin tizim), Kulchitskiy (K) hujayralari. Guruh bo'lib, ko'pincha nafas yo'llarining tarmoqlanish joylarida joylashadi.
💡 Mayda hujayrali o'pka saratoni va karsinoid o'smalar shu hujayralardan kelib chiqadi.

🔹 CHO'TKASIMON hujayralar - yuzasida kalta mikrovorsinkalar bor. Sekretini chiqarib bo'lgan qadahsimon hujayralar yoki kiprikli/qadahsimon hujayralarning oraliq bosqichi bo'lishi mumkin. Ba'zilari epiteliy ichidagi nervlar bilan sinaps hosil qiladi - SEZUVCHI retseptor bo'lishi mumkin.

bandlar: Columnar and goblet cells are sensitive to irritation
Irritation: taller ciliated cells, more goblet cells and submucosal glands
Intense irritation (smoking): ciliated epithelium -> stratified squamous
Squamous metaplasia is REVERSIBLE
Failed clearance -> infection or pneumoconiosis; CF: thick mucus, cilia cannot move it
postlar.izoh:
🚬 Chekish va nafas yo'li epiteliysi.

Silindrsimon va qadahsimon hujayralar ta'sirlanishga sezgir. Ta'sirlanish davom etsa:
• kiprikli hujayralar balandlashadi;
• qadahsimon hujayralar va shilliq osti bezlari soni ortadi (shuning uchun chekuvchilarda balg'am ko'p).

🔸 Kuchli va uzoq ta'sirlanishda (chekish) - YASSI HUJAYRALI METAPLAZIYA: ko'p qatorli kiprikli epiteliy ko'p qavatli yassi epiteliyga aylanadi. Bu himoya moslashuvi, lekin kiprikchalar yo'qoladi va tozalash buziladi.
✅ Bu jarayon QAYTAR - chekish tashlansa, epiteliy tiklanadi. (Davom etsa - displaziya va yassi hujayrali karsinoma xavfi.)

⚠️ Mukotsiliar tozalash samarasiz bo'lsa yoki 'zo'riqib' qolsa:
• infeksiya (patogen bakteriyalar);
• pnevmokonioz (changdan kelib chiqadigan kasallik).

Mukovissidozda shilliq juda quyuq va yopishqoq - kiprikchalar uni halqum tomon surishga qiynaladi, bemorlarda nafas yo'llari infeksiyalari tez-tez takrorlanadi.

bandlar: Nonciliated, low columnar/cuboidal cells with secretory granules
Located in bronchioles (especially terminal bronchioles)

postlar.izoh:
🔹 Klub hujayralari (eski nomi - Klara hujayralari).

Tuzilishi: KIPRIKSIZ, past silindrsimon yoki kubsimon hujayralar, sitoplazmasida SEKRETOR DONACHALAR bor. Bo'shliqqa gumbazsimon bo'rtib turadi.

Joylashuvi: bronxiolalarda, ayniqsa terminal bronxiolalarda (u yerda qadahsimon hujayralar deyarli yo'q).

Vazifalari - 3 ta (USMLE uchun yodlang):
1️⃣ Toksinlarni SITOXROM P-450 orqali parchalaydi (detoksikatsiya);
2️⃣ SURFAKTANT komponentini ajratadi;
3️⃣ Klub va kiprikli hujayralarning PROGENITOR (o'zak) hujayrasi - bronxiolalar shikastlanganda epiteliyni tiklaydi.

💡 Esda tuting: traxeya va bronxlarda o'zak hujayra - BAZAL hujayra; bronxiolalarda - KLUB hujayra; alveolalarda - II tip PNEVMOTSIT.

Sxemada terminal bronxiolaning ko'ndalang kesimi: klub hujayralari, silliq mushak qavati, tog'ay va bezlar yo'q.

bandlar: Autosomal recessive; CFTR gene on chromosome 7; most common: deltaF508
Most common lethal genetic disease in people of European ancestry
CFTR = ATP-gated Cl- channel: secretes Cl- in lungs/GI, reabsorbs Cl- in sweat glands
deltaF508: misfolded protein, improper trafficking -> absent from membrane
Less Cl- and water secretion -> more Na+ via ENaC -> more water reabsorbed -> thick mucus

postlar.sarlavha: Cystic fibrosis: diagnosis and clinical features
bandlar: High Cl- in pilocarpine-induced sweat test; newborn screen: high immunoreactive trypsinogen
Contraction alkalosis + hypokalemia (sweat losses, like a loop diuretic)
Lungs: S. aureus (childhood), P. aeruginosa (adults), ABPA, bronchiectasis
Nasal polyps, sinus opacification, clubbing; meconium ileus in newborns
Pancreatic insufficiency, steatorrhea, ADEK deficiency, CF diabetes, biliary cirrhosis; male infertility
postlar.izoh:
🩺 Mukovissidoz: tashxis va klinika.

🔬 Tashxis:
• pilokarpin bilan TER TESTI - terda Cl- YUQORI (ter bezida qayta so'rilmaydi);
• chaqaloqlar skriningi - qonda immunoreaktiv TRIPSINOGEN oshgan (me'da osti bezi yo'li tiqilib qolgani uchun).
• Elektrolitlar: ter bilan suv va Na+ yo'qotilishi -> KONTRAKSION ALKALOZ va GIPOKALIEMIYA (buyrak K+ va H+ ni yo'qotadi - halqa diuretigiga o'xshash ta'sir).

🫁 O'pka: takroriy infeksiyalar - erta bolalikda S. aureus, kattalarda P. aeruginosa; allergik bronxopulmonal aspergillyoz (ABPA); surunkali bronxit va BRONXOEKTAZLAR; rentgenda retikulonodulyar o'zgarish.
👃 Burun: poliplar, yon bo'shliqlar xiralashuvi; barmoqlar 'baraban tayoqchasi'.
🍽 Oshqozon-ichak: me'da osti bezi yetishmovchiligi, steatoreya, A, D, E, K vitaminlari yetishmasligi, keyinchalik mukovissidozli DIABET; biliar sirroz; yangi tug'ilganda MEKONIY ILEUS.
👨 Erkaklar: bepushtlik - urug' yo'li YO'Q (spermatogenez saqlangan bo'lishi mumkin). Ayollar: amenoreya, bachadon bo'yni shilliqi quyuq.

bandlar: Mucus clearance: chest physiotherapy, inhaled dornase alfa (DNase), inhaled hypertonic saline
Azithromycin prevents acute exacerbations; ibuprofen as anti-inflammatory
Pancrelipase for pancreatic insufficiency
CFTR potentiator (ivacaftor): holds the channel gate open
CFTR correctors (lumacaftor, tezacaftor): help folding -> protein reaches the membrane
postlar.izoh:
💊 Mukovissidoz davolash - kompleks (multifaktorial).

🔹 Shilliqni tozalash:
• ko'krak qafasi fizioterapiyasi;
• ingalyatsion DORNAZA ALFA (DNaza) - shilliqdagi DNKni parchalab, uni suyultiradi;
• ingalyatsion GIPERTONIK eritma - shilliqqa suv tortadi.

🔹 Infeksiya va yallig'lanish:
• AZITROMITSIN - o'tkir qo'zishlarning oldini oladi;
• IBUPROFEN - yallig'lanishga qarshi ta'sir.

🔹 Me'da osti bezi yetishmovchiligi - PANKRELIPAZA (fermentlar o'rnini bosish).

🔹 CFTR MODULYATORLARI - yakka yoki kombinatsiyada; samaradorligi mutatsiya turiga bog'liq (farmakogenomika):
• POTENSIATORLAR - kanal 'darvozasini' OCHIQ ushlab turadi, Cl- membrana orqali o'tadi. Misol: IVAKAFTOR.
• KORREKTORLAR - CFTR oqsiliga to'g'ri 3D shaklni olishga yordam beradi, oqsil hujayra yuzasiga chiqadi. Misol: LUMAKAFTOR, TEZAKAFTOR (deltaF508 uchun).

💡 USMLE: 'kanal membranada bor, lekin ochilmaydi' -> potensiator; 'oqsil membranaga yetib bormaydi' -> korrektor.

bandlar: Right ventricle: the most ANTERIOR part of the heart
RV is most commonly injured in anterior chest trauma (stab wounds)

postlar.izoh:
❤️ Yurakning joylashuvi - old va pastki yuzalar.

🔹 O'NG QORINCHA - yurakning eng OLDINGI qismi. To'sh suyagi va qovurg'a tog'aylari ortida yotadi. Shuning uchun ko'krakning old tomondan pichoq yoki o'q jarohatlarida eng ko'p o'ng qorincha shikastlanadi.

🔹 Pastki (diafragma) yuzasi:
• taxminan 2/3 qismi - chap qorincha;
• taxminan 1/3 qismi - o'ng qorincha.

💡 Klinik bog'liqlik:
• 'pastki infarkt' (II, III, aVF) - diafragma yuzasi, ko'pincha o'ng toj arteriyasi;
• PA rentgenda o'ng qorincha chegara hosil qilmaydi (oldinda), o'ng chegarani o'ng bo'lmacha hosil qiladi.

Rasmda yurak old tomondan: o'ng bo'lmacha, o'ng qorincha (old yuzaning katta qismi), chap qorinchaning bir qismi, aorta va o'pka ustuni, oldingi qorinchalararo egat.

postlar.sarlavha: Left atrium: the most posterior chamber
bandlar: LEFT ATRIUM is the most POSTERIOR part of the heart
Lies directly in front of the esophagus
Enlarged LA (e.g., mitral stenosis) -> compresses esophagus: dysphagia
Can compress the left recurrent laryngeal nerve -> hoarseness (Ortner syndrome)
Coronary sinus runs in the posterior (left) AV groove and drains into the RA
postlar.izoh:
❤️ Chap bo'lmacha - yurakning eng ORQA qismi.

• Chap bo'lmacha bevosita QIZILO'NGACH oldida yotadi (shuning uchun transezofageal exokardiografiyada u juda yaxshi ko'rinadi).

⚠️ Chap bo'lmacha kattalashsa (masalan, MITRAL STENOZDA yoki bo'lmachalar fibrillyatsiyasida):
• qizilo'ngachni ezadi -> yutish qiyinlashadi (DISFAGIYA);
• chap qaytuvchi hiqildoq nervini (adashgan nerv tarmog'i) ezadi -> ovoz BO'G'ILADI. Bu holat ORTNER sindromi deyiladi.

🔹 Toj sinus (sinus coronarius) - yurakning orqa tomonida, chap bo'lmacha-qorincha egatida yotadi; yurak venalari qonini yig'ib, O'NG BO'LMACHAGA quyadi.

Rasmda yurak pastdan-orqadan: chap bo'lmacha va o'pka venalari, pastki kovak vena, toj sinus, katta, o'rta va kichik yurak venalari.

bandlar: 3 layers (outer -> inner): fibrous pericardium, parietal pericardium, epicardium (visceral)
Pericardial space: between parietal pericardium and epicardium
Innervated by the phrenic nerve
Pericarditis: referred pain to neck, arms, one or both shoulders (often left)
postlar.izoh:
🛡 Perikard - yurak xaltasi.

Qavatlari (tashqaridan ichkariga):
1. FIBROZ perikard - zich, cho'zilmaydigan tashqi qavat; yurakni haddan tashqari kengayishdan saqlaydi;
2. PARIETAL (seroz) perikard - fibroz qavatning ichki yuzasini qoplaydi;
3. EPIKARD (visseral perikard) - yurak yuzasiga yopishgan.

🔹 Perikard bo'shlig'i - parietal perikard va epikard orasida; oz miqdorda seroz suyuqlik bor. Bu bo'shliqda suyuqlik yoki qon tez to'plansa - yurak tamponadasi.

⚡️ Innervatsiya: DIAFRAGMA NERVI (C3-C5). Rasmda ikkala diafragma nervi perikardning yon tomonlaridan pastga tushib borayotgani ko'rinadi.

🩺 Shuning uchun PERIKARDIT og'rig'i bo'yin, qo'llar, bir yoki ikkala YELKAGA (ko'pincha chapga) uzatiladi. Og'riq odatda oldinga engashganda kamayadi, chalqancha yotganda kuchayadi.

postlar.izoh:
🫀 Toj qon aylanishining dominantligi, oqim va venoz chiqish.

📌 DOMINANTLIK - orqa qorinchalararo arteriya (PDA) qayerdan chiqishiga qarab aniqlanadi:
• O'NG dominant (eng ko'p uchraydi, ~80-85%) - PDA o'ng toj arteriyasidan (RCA);

• chaqaloqlarda yoki kattalikda aniqlanadi;

Qoplamalari: urug' tizimchasining UCHALA fassiyasi (ichki urug' fassiyasi, kremaster fassiyasi, tashqi urug' fassiyasi).

Rasmda chov kanalining orqa devori ichkaridan: chuqur halqa, pastki epigastral tomirlar, urug' yo'li va moyak tomirlari.

💧 KATTA qorin parda xaltasi va suyuqlik harakati.

Katta xalta - qorin parda bo'shlig'ining qolgan qismi, diafragmadan tosgacha. Unda cho'ntaklar, chuqurchalar va YONBOSH (PARAKOLIK) ARIQCHALAR bor - ular orqali qorin parda suyuqligi aylanadi.

1️⃣ Me'yorda: suyuqlik ko'tariluvchi va tushuvchi chambar ichak yonidagi ariqchalar bo'ylab YUQORIGA - diafragma ostidagi chuqurchaga oqadi va diafragma LIMFA tomirlariga so'riladi.

2️⃣ O'TIRGAN yoki TIK turgan bemorda ortiqcha suyuqlik (peritonit, assit) ariqchalar bo'ylab PASTGA oqadi:
• erkaklarda - to'g'ri ichak-qovuq cho'ntagiga;
• ayollarda - to'g'ri ichak-bachadon (Duglas) cho'ntagiga.

3️⃣ CHALQANCHA yotgan bemorda - YUQORIGA, diafragma osti va JIGAR-BUYRAK (Morison) chuqurchasiga. Jigar-buyrak chuqurchasi bu holatda qorin parda bo'shlig'ining ENG PAST nuqtasi.
⚠️ Diafragma nervi (C3-C5) ta'sirlanib, YELKA og'rig'i bo'lishi mumkin.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Posterior to and outside of the peritoneal cavity
Injury -> blood or gas accumulates in the retroperitoneal space
SAD PUCKER: Suprarenal glands, Aorta + IVC, Duodenum (2nd-4th parts)
Pancreas (except tail), Ureters, Colon (ascending + descending), Kidneys
Esophagus (thoracic part), Rectum (partially)

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Falciform: liver -> anterior abdominal wall; contains ligamentum teres hepatis (fetal umbilical vein) + paraumbilical veins
Hepatoduodenal: liver -> duodenum; contains PORTAL TRIAD
Portal triad: proper hepatic artery, portal vein, common bile duct
Pringle maneuver: compress it at the omental foramen to control hepatic inflow bleeding
Borders the omental foramen; part of the lesser omentum (both from ventral mesentery)
postlar.izoh:
🔗 Qorin bo'shlig'i boylamlari (1-qism) - VENTRAL tutqich hosilalari.

🔹 O'ROQSIMON boylam (lig. falciforme) - jigardan qorin OLD devoriga.
Ichida: jigarning YUMALOQ BOYLAMI (lig. teres hepatis) - homiladagi KINDIK VENASINING qoldig'i; va ochiq qolishi mumkin bo'lgan kindik oldi venalari (portal gipertenziyada 'meduza boshi').

🔹 JIGAR-O'N IKKI BARMOQLI ICHAK boylami (lig. hepatoduodenale) - jigardan o'n ikki barmoqli ichakka.
Ichida - PORTAL TRIADA:
• xususiy jigar arteriyasi;
• darvoza venasi;
• umumiy o't yo'li.
• CHARVI TESHIGINI (katta va kichik xaltalarni bog'lovchi) oldindan chegaralaydi;
• kichik charvining bir qismi.

✋ PRINGL manyovri: shu boylam charvi teshigi sohasida qo'l yoki qisqich bilan qisiladi. Agar jigardan qon ketish TO'XTASA - manba KIRUVCHI tomirlar (darvoza venasi, jigar arteriyasi); to'xtamasa - CHIQUVCHI (jigar venalari, pastki kovak vena).

Rasmda charvi teshigiga kirish: jigar ko'tarilgan, lig. hepatoduodenale, foramen epiploicum (Winslowi).

postlar.sarlavha: Hepatogastric, gastrocolic, gastrosplenic and splenorenal ligaments
bandlar: Hepatogastric: liver -> lesser curvature; gastric vessels; may be cut to access lesser sac
Hepatogastric (ventral mesentery): separates greater and lesser sacs on the right
Gastrocolic: greater curvature -> transverse colon; gastroepiploic arteries
Gastrosplenic: greater curvature -> spleen; short gastrics, left gastroepiploic; separates sacs on the left
Splenorenal: spleen -> left pararenal space; splenic artery + vein, tail of pancreas
