bandlar: Inside -> out (MSMS): Mucosa, Submucosa, Muscularis externa, Serosa
Mucosa: epithelium, lamina propria, muscularis mucosae
Submucosa: submucosal (Meissner) plexus - secretion; Muscularis: myenteric (Auerbach) - motility
Serosa if intraperitoneal; adventitia if retroperitoneal; erosion = mucosa only, ulcer deeper
Slow waves (interstitial cells of Cajal): duodenum > ileum > stomach
postlar.izoh:
🧱 Ovqat hazm qilish yo'li devori - ichkaridan tashqariga: MSMS.

1️⃣ SHILLIQ qavat (Mucosa): epiteliy, xususiy plastinka (lamina propria), shilliq qavat mushak plastinkasi (muscularis mucosae).
2️⃣ SHILLIQ OSTI qavat (Submucosa): ichida MEYSNER (submukoz) nerv chigali - SEKRETSIYA va qon oqimini boshqaradi.
3️⃣ MUSHAK qavati (Muscularis externa): ichki aylanma va tashqi bo'ylama qatlam; ular orasida AUERBAX (miyenterik) nerv chigali - MOTORIKA.
4️⃣ SEROZ qavat (Serosa) - intraperitoneal a'zolarda; ADVENTITSIYA - retroperitoneal a'zolarda.

💡 Patologiya:
• EROZIYA - faqat shilliq qavatda;
• YARA - shilliq osti, ichki yoki tashqi mushak qavatlarigacha chuqurlashadi.

⚡️ Sekin to'lqinlar (bazal elektr ritmi) - KAXAL interstitsial hujayralaridan; chastotasi: o'n ikki barmoqli ichak > yonbosh ichak > me'da.

💡 Girshprung kasalligida aynan shu nerv chigallari (Meysner va Auerbax) yo'q.

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Esophagus: nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium
Esophagus: upper 1/3 striated, middle + lower 2/3 smooth muscle (some overlap)
Stomach: parietal cells eosinophilic (pink), chief cells basophilic
Duodenum: villi + microvilli; Brunner glands (HCO3-) in submucosa
Crypts of Lieberkuhn: stem cells + Paneth cells (defensins, lysozyme, TNF); plicae circulares distally

rasm.manba: Sxema: USMLE Pulsi

bandlar: Jejunum: villi, crypts, plicae circulares - taller, more prominent and numerous than ileum
Jejunum: 'feathered' appearance with oral contrast; more surface area
Ileum: Peyer patches (lymphoid aggregates in lamina propria + submucosa)
Ileum: plicae circulares proximally; largest number of goblet cells in small intestine
Colon: crypts of Lieberkuhn with abundant goblet cells, NO villi

savollar.vinyetka: A 3-month-old boy has an intermittent bulge in the right groin that extends into the scrotum when he cries. At surgery, the hernia sac is found entering the inguinal canal lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels.
savollar.savol: Failure of which embryologic process caused this hernia?
savollar.izoh: Qiyshiq chov churrasi: qin o'simtasi yopilmagan, chuqur halqa orqali epigastral tomirlardan LATERALDA kiradi va yorg'oqqa tushadi. Gidrotsele ham shu sababdan.

savollar.vinyetka: A 72-year-old man with chronic constipation and benign prostatic hyperplasia has a groin bulge that appears on straining and disappears when he lies down. At surgery the bulge is medial to the inferior epigastric vessels.
savollar.savol: Weakness of which structure is the main cause?
javoblar: Transversalis fascia in the Hesselbach triangle
savollar.izoh: To'g'ri chov churrasi: Hesselbax uchburchagida ko'ndalang fassiya zaiflashadi, epigastral tomirlardan MEDIALDA. Keksa erkaklar, kuchanish (qabziyat, BPH).

savollar.vinyetka: A 65-year-old woman has a painful, tender, irreducible lump in the right groin with vomiting. The mass lies below the inguinal ligament and lateral to the pubic tubercle.
savollar.savol: Through which space did this hernia most likely pass?
javoblar: Femoral canal, medial to the femoral vein
savollar.izoh: Son churrasi: son kanali orqali, chov boylamidan pastda, son venasidan medialda. Ayollarda ko'proq va qisilish xavfi eng yuqori - shoshilinch operatsiya.

savollar.vinyetka: A 28-year-old man is diagnosed with a seminoma of the left testis. Staging CT is ordered to look for lymph node metastases.
savollar.savol: Which lymph nodes are the first to be involved?
savollar.izoh: Moyak limfasi moyak tomirlari bo'ylab bel (aorta yoni) tugunlariga boradi. Yorg'oq terisi esa yuza chov tugunlariga - farqini eslab qoling.

savollar.vinyetka: After an open inguinal hernia repair, a 35-year-old man is found to have absent elevation of the testis when the skin of his upper medial thigh is stroked. Sensation over the thigh is normal.
savollar.savol: Injury to which nerve best explains this finding?
javoblar: Genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve
savollar.izoh: Kremaster refleksi: sezuvchi - yonbosh-chov nervi (L1), harakat - son-jinsiy nervning jinsiy tarmog'i. Sezgi saqlangan, javob yo'q -> harakat tarmog'i shikastlangan.

savollar.vinyetka: A full-term newborn develops severe respiratory distress immediately after birth. The abdomen is scaphoid, and bowel sounds are heard over the left hemithorax. Chest X-ray shows bowel loops in the left chest with mediastinal shift to the right.
savollar.savol: Which embryologic defect is most likely responsible?
javoblar: Incomplete closure of the pleuroperitoneal membrane
Failure of the septum transversum to form the central tendon only
savollar.izoh: Tug'ma diafragma churrasi: plevra-qorinparda membranasi yopilmagan, ko'pincha CHAPda (o'ngni jigar himoyalaydi). Qorin 'botiq', o'pka gipoplaziyasi xavfi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old obese woman has chronic heartburn and regurgitation. Barium swallow shows the gastroesophageal junction located above the diaphragm, with an 'hourglass' configuration of the stomach.
savollar.savol: What type of hernia is present?
savollar.izoh: Sirpanuvchi hiatal churra: me'da-qizilo'ngach tutashuvi diafragmadan yuqoriga siljiydi, 'qum soati' ko'rinishi, GERK. Paraezofagealda tutashuv joyida qoladi.

savollar.vinyetka: During laparotomy for a liver laceration after a car crash, the surgeon places a vascular clamp across the free edge of the lesser omentum at the omental foramen to control bleeding.
savollar.savol: Which structures are compressed by this maneuver?
javoblar: Proper hepatic artery, portal vein and common bile duct
Hepatic veins and inferior vena cava
savollar.izoh: Pringl manyovri: jigar-o'n ikki barmoqli ichak boylami (portal triada) qisiladi. Qon ketish davom etsa, manba jigar venalari yoki pastki kovak vena.

savollar.vinyetka: A 50-year-old man with a perforated duodenal ulcer has been lying flat in bed for several hours. He develops generalized peritonitis.
savollar.savol: In this position, where does peritoneal fluid tend to collect at the lowest point of the peritoneal cavity?
savollar.izoh: Chalqancha yotganda eng past nuqta - jigar-buyrak chuqurchasi. Tik turganda suyuqlik erkaklarda to'g'ri ichak-qovuq, ayollarda to'g'ri ichak-bachadon cho'ntagiga oqadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A pathology resident examines a biopsy from the small intestine. It shows villi on the surface and coiled bicarbonate-secreting mucous glands located in the submucosa.
savollar.savol: From which part of the GI tract was the biopsy most likely taken?
savollar.izoh: Shilliq osti qavatdagi Brunner bezlari (bikarbonat) faqat o'n ikki barmoqli ichakda. Yonbosh ichakda - Peyer pilakchalari, yo'g'on ichakda vorsinka yo'q.

savollar.vinyetka: A 34-year-old woman undergoes laparoscopic surgery. The surgeon notes a band of tissue traveling through the right inguinal canal from the uterus toward the labium majus.
savollar.savol: This structure is the embryologic homologue of which male structure?
savollar.izoh: Ayollarda chov kanalidan bachadonning yumaloq boylami o'tadi - erkaklardagi gubernaculum testis gomologi. U kaudal jinsiy boylam qoldig'i.

savollar.vinyetka: A 31-year-old man has a dull ache in the left scrotum that worsens with standing. Examination shows a 'bag of worms' above the left testis that decreases when he lies down.
savollar.savol: Dilation of which structure explains this finding?
savollar.izoh: Varikotsele - pampinform venoz chigal kengayishi ('chuvalchanglar xaltasi'). Bu chigal moyakni sovutadi; kengaysa harorat oshib, bepushtlik xavfi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 45-year-old man is evaluated for a groin bulge. When the examiner invaginates the scrotal skin and places a finger in the superficial inguinal ring, a mass strikes the TIP of the finger on coughing.
savollar.savol: Which type of hernia is most likely?
savollar.izoh: Qiyshiq churra kanal bo'ylab keladi va barmoq UCHIGA uriladi; to'g'ri churra devordan bevosita bo'rtib, barmoq YUMSHOQ qismiga (pulpa) tegadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A cardiology fellow plans femoral venous access. She palpates the femoral arterial pulse just below the inguinal ligament.
savollar.savol: Where should the needle be directed to reach the femoral vein?
javoblar: Just medial to the femoral artery
Just lateral to the femoral artery
Directly beneath the inguinal ligament midpoint, deep to the nerve
Into the femoral canal medial to the lymph nodes
savollar.izoh: NAVEL - lateraldan medialga: nerv, arteriya, vena, bo'sh joy, limfa. Vena arteriyadan medialda. Nerv son g'ilofidan tashqarida, eng lateralda.

savollar.vinyetka: A 62-year-old woman has a painful mass in the lower abdomen lateral to the rectus abdominis, below the umbilicus. Physical examination is equivocal; ultrasound shows a defect in the aponeurosis along the semilunar line.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely diagnosis?
savollar.izoh: Spigel churrasi - to'g'ri mushak va yarimoysimon chiziq orasidagi aponevroz nuqsoni, ko'pincha qorin pastida (orqa qin yo'q). Tashxis - UTT, KT.

savollar.vinyetka: A 40-year-old man has a perforated posterior gastric ulcer. Imaging shows fluid collecting directly behind the stomach, separate from the rest of the peritoneal cavity.
savollar.savol: Through which opening does this space communicate with the greater sac?
savollar.izoh: Me'da orqasidagi kichik charvi xaltasi katta xalta bilan charvi (Vinslov) teshigi orqali tutashadi. Teshik oldida - lig. hepatoduodenale (portal triada).

savollar.vinyetka: A 50-year-old man is stabbed in the back. CT shows a hematoma limited to the space behind the parietal peritoneum, surrounding the second part of the duodenum and the head of the pancreas.
savollar.savol: Which of the following organs is also located in this space?
savollar.izoh: SAD PUCKER: buyrak usti, aorta/PKV, duodenum 2-4, me'da osti bezi (dumsiz), siydik nayi, ko'tariluvchi va tushuvchi chambar ichak, buyrak, qizilo'ngach, rektum.
